1.61.s: pra viśataṃ prāṇāpānāv anaḍvāhāv iva vrajam | śarīram asyāṅgāni jarimṇe nayataṃ yuvam ||
1.61.d: प्र विशतं प्राणापानाव् अनड्वाहाव् इव व्रजम् । शरीरम् अस्याङ्गानि जरिम्णे नयतं युवम् ॥

1.61.s: ihaiva staṃ prāṇāpānau memaṃ hāsiṣṭaṃ mṛtyave | ayaṃ jarimṇaḥ śevadhir ariṣṭa iha vardhatām ||
1.61.d: इहैव स्तं प्राणापानौ मेमं हासिष्टं मृत्यवे । अयं जरिम्णः शेवधिर् अरिष्ट इह वर्धताम् ॥

1.61.s: jarase tvā pari dadhmo jarase ni dhuyāmasi | jarā tvā bhadrayā neṣat | vy anye yantu mṛtyavo yān āhur itarāñ chatam ||
1.61.d: जरसे त्वा परि दध्मो जरसे नि धुयामसि । जरा त्वा भद्रया नेषत् । व्य् अन्ये यन्तु मृत्यवो यान् आहुर् इतराञ् छतम् ॥

1.62.s: muñcāmi tvā haviṣā jīvanāya kam ajñātayakṣmād uta rājakṣmāt | grāhyā gṛbhīto yady eṣa etat tata indrāgnī pra mumuktam enam ||
1.62.d: मुञ्चामि त्वा हविषा जीवनाय कम् अज्ञातयक्ष्माद् उत राजक्ष्मात् । ग्राह्या गृभीतो यद्य् एष एतत् तत इन्द्राग्नी प्र मुमुक्तम् एनम् ॥

1.62.s: yadi kṣitāyur yadi vā pareto yadi mṛtyor antikaṃ nīta eva | tam ā harāmi nirṛter upasthād aspārṣam enaṃ śataśāradāya ||
1.62.d: यदि क्षितायुर् यदि वा परेतो यदि मृत्योर् अन्तिकं नीत एव । तम् आ हरामि निरृतेर् उपस्थाद् अस्पार्षम् एनं शतशारदाय ॥

1.62.s: sahasrākṣeṇa śatavīryeṇa śatāyuṣā haviṣāhārṣam enam | indro yathainaṃ jarase nayāty ati viśvasya duritasya pāram ||
1.62.d: सहस्राक्षेण शतवीर्येण शतायुषा हविषाहार्षम् एनम् । इन्द्रो यथैनं जरसे नयात्य् अति विश्वस्य दुरितस्य पारम् ॥

1.62.s: śataṃ jīva śarado vardhamānaḥ śataṃ hemantāñ chatam u vasantān | śatam indrāgnī savitā bṛhaspatiḥ śatāyuṣā haviṣāhārṣam enam ||
1.62.d: शतं जीव शरदो वर्धमानः शतं हेमन्ताञ् छतम् उ वसन्तान् । शतम् इन्द्राग्नी सविता बृहस्पतिः शतायुषा हविषाहार्षम् एनम् ॥

1.63.s: yat te annaṃ bhuvaspata ākṣiyeta pṛthivīm anu | tasya nas tvaṃ bhuvaspate saṃ pra yaccha prajāpate ||
1.63.d: यत् ते अन्नं भुवस्पत आक्षियेत पृथिवीम् अनु । तस्य नस् त्वं भुवस्पते सं प्र यच्छ प्रजापते ॥

1.63.s: vyātte parameṣṭhino brahmaṇāpīpadāma tam | saṃvatsarasya daṃṣṭrābhyāṃ hetis taṃ sam adhād abhi ||
1.63.d: व्यात्ते परमेष्ठिनो ब्रह्मणापीपदाम तम् । संवत्सरस्य दंष्ट्राभ्यां हेतिस् तं सम् अधाद् अभि ॥

1.63.s: iyaṃ taṃ bhavastv āhutiḥ samid devī sahīyasī | rājño varuṇasya bandho asi so 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ahne rātraye badhāna ||
1.63.d: इयं तं भवस्त्व् आहुतिः समिद् देवी सहीयसी । राज्ञो वरुणस्य बन्धो असि सो ऽमुम् आमुष्यायणम् अमुष्याः पुत्रम् अह्ने रात्रये बधान ॥

1.63.s: mṛṇo 'si deva savitar gāyatreṇa chandasā mṛṇāmuṣya paśūn dvipadaś catuṣpadaḥ | yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ jahi taṃ mṛṇa tasmai mā mīmṛḍas tasmai durāhā ||
1.63.d: मृणो ऽसि देव सवितर् गायत्रेण छन्दसा मृणामुष्य पशून् द्विपदश् चतुष्पदः । यो ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस् तं जहि तं मृण तस्मै मा मीमृडस् तस्मै दुराहा ॥
1.63.m:
Cast a counter-spell against him who hates us, whom we hate!

You are a crusher, O divine Savitṛ, with the gāyatrī meter; / crush the two-footed and four-footed cattle of yonder one! / Him who hates us, whom we hate— / slay him, crush him, do not pity him; for him [be] an evil end!

1.64.s: ni te padaṃ pade mama ni cittam etu niṣkṛtaḥ | yathāsaḥ kevalo mama ahaṃ sādhāraṇī tava ||
1.64.d: नि ते पदं पदे मम नि चित्तम् एतु निष्कृतः । यथासः केवलो मम अहं साधारणी तव ॥
1.64.m: Down let your foot [come] upon my foot, / down let your mind come from the meeting-place, / so that you will be mine alone, / [and] I shall be shared with you.

1.64.s: padena gām anu yanti padenāśvaṃ padā ratham | padena maryā mat tvaṃ na eṣo no ahaṃ tvat ||
1.64.d: पदेन गाम् अनु यन्ति पदेनाश्वं पदा रथम् । पदेन मर्या मत् त्वं न एषो नो अहं त्वत् ॥
1.64.m: By track they follow a cow, / by track a horse, by track a chariot. / By track, O young man, from me you / must not go, nor I from you!

1.64.s: māpa sṛpo mā parā sṛpo mānyatrāsman manas kṛthāḥ | yaṃ tvāhir iva bhogair nākulena parīmasi ||
1.64.d: माप सृपो मा परा सृपो मान्यत्रास्मन् मनस् कृथाः । यं त्वाहिर् इव भोगैर् नाकुलेन परीमसि ॥
1.64.m: Do not crawl away, do not crawl far off, / do not set your mind elsewhere than on us! / As a snake with its coils, / we encircle you with a mongoose-[charm].

1.64.s: ni tvā kṛṇve saṃnahane ni kurīre ny opaśe | ni tvādhamasmiṃl lomni ny u tvā muṣkayor mṛje ||
1.64.d: नि त्वा कृण्वे संनहने नि कुरीरे न्य् ओपशे । नि त्वाधमस्मिंल् लोम्नि न्य् उ त्वा मुष्कयोर् मृजे ॥
1.64.m: I place you down in the headband, / in the kurīra-head ornament, down in the top-knot; / down in this lowest hair I place you, / and down into the two testicles I rub you.

1.65.s: ghṛtāhutā pṛthivī mā na eno 'smān prajāṃ vocata kilbiṣāṇi | anāturāḥ sumanasaḥ suvīrā jyog jīvantas tava sakhye syāma ||
1.65.d: घृताहुता पृथिवी मा न एनो ऽस्मान् प्रजां वोचत किल्बिषाणि । अनातुराः सुमनसः सुवीरा ज्योग् जीवन्तस् तव सख्ये स्याम ॥
1.65.m: O earth, offered to with ghee, let not sin / or offenses proclaim us and our offspring! / Free from illness, well-minded, rich in heroes, / living long, may we abide in your friendship!

1.65.s: antar emi yātudhānān antar emi kimīdinaḥ | dhiyāma pitryā vayaṃ sarasvatyā carāmasi ||
1.65.d: अन्तर् एमि यातुधानान् अन्तर् एमि किमीदिनः । धियाम पित्र्या वयं सरस्वत्या चरामसि ॥
1.65.m: I go between the sorcerers, / I go between the Kimīdins. / We / walk with Sarasvatī.

1.65.s: mā te riṣaṃ khanitā yasmai ca tvā khanāmasi | dvipāc catuṣpād asmākaṃ mā riṣad devy oṣadhe ||
1.65.d: मा ते रिषं खनिता यस्मै च त्वा खनामसि । द्विपाच् चतुष्पाद् अस्माकं मा रिषद् देव्य् ओषधे ॥
1.65.m: May your digger not be harmed, / nor he for whom we dig you up! / May our two-footed and four-footed [creatures] / not be harmed, O divine plant!

1.65.s: anyā vo anyām avatv anyānyasyā upāvata | sadhrīcīḥ savratā bhūtvā asyāvata vīryam ||
1.65.d: अन्या वो अन्याम् अवत्व् अन्यान्यस्या उपावत । सध्रीचीः सव्रता भूत्वा अस्यावत वीर्यम् ॥
1.65.m: Let one of you help the other, / assist one another! / United, of the same vow, / promote its strength!

1.66.s: dhruvas tiṣṭha bhuvanasya gopa mā saṃ vikthā vanaspate | atraiva tvam iha vayaṃ suvīrā viśvā mṛdho abhimātīr vy asya ||
1.66.d: ध्रुवस् तिष्ठ भुवनस्य गोप मा सं विक्था वनस्पते । अत्रैव त्वम् इह वयं सुवीरा विश्वा मृधो अभिमातीर् व्य् अस्य ॥
1.66.m: Stand firm, O guardian of the world, / do not tremble, O lord of the forest! / Right here be you, here let us be rich in heroes; / scatter away all adversaries, the plotters!

1.66.s: yo vānaspatyānām adhipatir babhūva yasminn imā viśvā bhuvanāny ārpitā | tam anajmi madhunā daivyena tasmān maṇiṃ nir mame viśvarūpam ||
1.66.d: यो वानस्पत्यानाम् अधिपतिर् बभूव यस्मिन्न् इमा विश्वा भुवनान्य् आर्पिता । तम् अनज्मि मधुना दैव्येन तस्मान् मणिं निर् ममे विश्वरूपम् ॥
1.66.m: He who became sovereign over the trees of the forest, / in whom all these worlds are fixed— / him I anoint with divine honey; / from him I fashioned the all-formed amulet.

1.66.s: imaṃ maṇiṃ viśvajitaṃ suvīram asmād aśvatthāt pary ud bharāmi | yena viśvāḥ pṛtanāḥ saṃjayāny atho dyumat samitim ā vadāni ||
1.66.d: इमं मणिं विश्वजितं सुवीरम् अस्माद् अश्वत्थात् पर्य् उद् भरामि । येन विश्वाः पृतनाः संजयान्य् अथो द्युमत् समितिम् आ वदानि ॥
1.66.m: This all-conquering, hero-granting amulet / I take forth from this Aśvattha, / by which I shall win all battles, / and speak with radiance in the assembly.

1.66.s: sabandhuś cāsabandhuś ca yo na indrābhidāsati | vṛścāmi tasyāhaṃ mūlaṃ prajāṃ cakṣur atho balam ||
1.66.d: सबन्धुश् चासबन्धुश् च यो न इन्द्राभिदासति । वृश्चामि तस्याहं मूलं प्रजां चक्षुर् अथो बलम् ॥
1.66.m: Whether related or unrelated, / whoever plots against us, O Indra— / I cut down his root, / his offspring, his sight, and his strength.

1.67.s: devī devyāṃ jātāsi pṛthivyām adhy oṣadhe | tāṃ tvā nitatni keśebhyo dṛṃhaṇāya khanāmasi ||
1.67.d: देवी देव्यां जातासि पृथिव्याम् अध्य् ओषधे । तां त्वा नितत्नि केशेभ्यो दृंहणाय खनामसि ॥
1.67.m: A goddess, born on the divine / earth, O plant: / as such, O Nitatnī, for the hair, / for strengthening, do we dig you up.

1.67.s: indras tvākhanat prathamo varuṇasya duhitṛbhyaḥ | dṛṃha jātāñ janayājātān ye jātās tān u varṣīyasas kṛdhi ||
1.67.d: इन्द्रस् त्वाखनत् प्रथमो वरुणस्य दुहितृभ्यः । दृंह जाताञ् जनयाजातान् ये जातास् तान् उ वर्षीयसस् कृधि ॥
1.67.m: Indra first dug you up / for Varuṇa's daughters. / Strengthen those that have grown, produce the unborn, / and those that are grown, make taller!

1.67.s: yas te keśo 'vatataḥ samūlo yaś ca vṛhyate | sarvaṃ taṃ viśvabheṣajyā abhi ṣiñcāmi vīrudhā ||
1.67.d: यस् ते केशो ऽवततः समूलो यश् च वृह्यते । सर्वं तं विश्वभेषज्या अभि षिञ्चामि वीरुधा ॥
1.67.m: Whatever hair of yours has fallen out, / and whatever is torn out with the root— / all that with the all-healing / plant do I sprinkle over.

1.67.s: abhīśunā meyo 'stu viyāmenānumeyaḥ | keśo naḍa iva vardhatāṃ śīrṣṇas te asitas pari ||
1.67.d: अभीशुना मेयो ऽस्तु वियामेनानुमेयः । केशो नड इव वर्धतां शीर्ष्णस् ते असितस् परि ॥
1.67.m: Measurable by a rein let it be, / to be measured by an outstretched arm! / Like a reed let the hair grow / dark from your head!

1.68.s: yathā naḍaṃ kaśipune striyo bhindanty aśmanā | evā bhinadmi te muṣkau tasmai tvām avase huve ||
1.68.d: यथा नडं कशिपुने स्त्रियो भिन्दन्त्य् अश्मना । एवा भिनद्मि ते मुष्कौ तस्मै त्वाम् अवसे हुवे ॥
1.68.m: Just as women crush a reed / for a cushion with a stone, / even so I crush your two testicles; / for this I invoke you for aid.

1.68.s: tvaṃ vīrudhāṃ śreṣṭhatamā abhiśrutāsy oṣadhe | sāmum adya pūruṣaṃ klībam opaśinaṃ kṛdhi ||
1.68.d: त्वं वीरुधां श्रेष्ठतमा अभिश्रुतास्य् ओषधे । सामुम् अद्य पूरुषं क्लीबम् ओपशिनं कृधि ॥
1.68.m: You are celebrated as the very best / of the plants, O herb! / Make that man yonder today / an impotent man wearing a top-knot!

1.68.s: klībaṃ kṛdhy opaśinam atho kurīriṇaṃ kṛdhi | ubhābhyām asya grāvabhyām indro bhinattv āṇḍyau ||
1.68.d: क्लीबं कृध्य् ओपशिनम् अथो कुरीरिणं कृधि । उभाभ्याम् अस्य ग्रावभ्याम् इन्द्रो भिनत्त्व् आण्ड्यौ ॥
1.68.m: Make him impotent, wearing a top-knot, / and make him wear a kurīra-ornament! / With both his pressing-stones, / let Indra crush his two testicles!

1.68.s: klība klībaṃ tvākaraṃ vadhre vadhriṃ tvākaram | arasārasaṃ tvākaram arasāraso 'si | kurīram asya śīrṣaṇi kumbaṃ cādhi ni dadhmasi ||
1.68.d: क्लीब क्लीबं त्वाकरं वध्रे वध्रिं त्वाकरम् । अरसारसं त्वाकरम् अरसारसो ऽसि । कुरीरम् अस्य शीर्षणि कुम्बं चाधि नि दध्मसि ॥
1.68.m: Impotent one, I have made you impotent; / gelding, I have made you a gelding; / sapless one, I have made you sapless: / you are sapless! / And upon his head / we place a kurīra-ornament.

1.68.s: ye te nāḍyau devakṛte yayos tiṣṭhati vṛṣṇyam | te te bhinadmi śamyayā amuṣyā adhi muṣkayoḥ ||
1.68.d: ये ते नाड्यौ देवकृते ययोस् तिष्ठति वृष्ण्यम् । ते ते भिनद्मि शम्यया अमुष्या अधि मुष्कयोः ॥
1.68.m: The two vessels of yours made by the gods, / in which virility resides— / I break those two for you / upon the testicles of that one.

1.69.s: jāyamāno nir arujat sapatnān dodhato 'bhayān | sa vai sapatnānāṃ sabhā avālapsyo anāśayat ||
1.69.d: जायमानो निर् अरुजत् सपत्नान् दोधतो ऽभयान् । स वै सपत्नानां सभा अवालप्स्यो अनाशयत् ॥
1.69.m: Being born, he crushed / the rivals, shaking and fearless; / he, the Avālapsya, / destroyed the assembly of rivals.

1.69.s: ārād arātiṃ kṛṇute aśastim apa bādhate | avālapsyaḥ sa yo maṇiḥ sahasvān abhimātihā ||
1.69.d: आराद् अरातिं कृणुते अशस्तिम् अप बाधते । अवालप्स्यः स यो मणिः सहस्वान् अभिमातिहा ॥
1.69.m: He sets hostility afar, / he repels dispraise— / the Avālapsya, that amulet, / powerful, slayer of plotters.

1.69.s: cakṣur asya sūtram āsīt tardma śrotram utābharat | avālapsyaḥ sa yo maṇiḥ sahasvān abhimātihā ||
1.69.d: चक्षुर् अस्य सूत्रम् आसीत् तर्द्म श्रोत्रम् उताभरत् । अवालप्स्यः स यो मणिः सहस्वान् अभिमातिहा ॥
1.69.m: Sight was his cord, / hearing he brought along— / the Avālapsya, that amulet, / powerful, slayer of plotters.

1.69.s: imaṃ maṇim āvālapsyaṃ yasminn ārohayāmasi | sa vai sapatnān ā datte sa enaṃ pātu viśvataḥ sa enaṃ jarase nayāt ||
1.69.d: इमं मणिम् आवालप्स्यं यस्मिन्न् आरोहयामसि । स वै सपत्नान् आ दत्ते स एनं पातु विश्वतः स एनं जरसे नयात् ॥
1.69.m: Upon whom we mount / this Avālapsya amulet, / he indeed captures his rivals; / let it protect him on all sides, / let it lead him to old age!

1.70.s: yato jīvebhyo na pitṝn upaiti yam ānaśe duṣkṛtaṃ daidhiṣavyam | ayajñiyaḥ prathamo yo viveśa kṛcchrād ij jyotir abhy aśnavātai ||
1.70.d: यतो जीवेभ्यो न पितॄन् उपैति यम् आनशे दुष्कृतं दैधिषव्यम् । अयज्ञियः प्रथमो यो विवेश कृच्छ्राद् इज् ज्योतिर् अभ्य् अश्नवातै ॥
1.70.m: Because he does not go from the living to the ancestors, / who has incurred the sin of marrying a younger sister first; / he who, unworthy of sacrifice, entered first, / only from distress may he reach the light!

1.70.s: nāsyauṣadhīṣv apy asti nāpsv antar nāsya sūryaṃ saṃdṛśam eti cakṣuḥ | bhūmir dveṣṭi carantam enaṃ yam ānaśe duṣkṛtaṃ daidhiṣavyam ||
1.70.d: नास्यौषधीष्व् अप्य् अस्ति नाप्स्व् अन्तर् नास्य सूर्यं संदृशम् एति चक्षुः । भूमिर् द्वेष्टि चरन्तम् एनं यम् आनशे दुष्कृतं दैधिषव्यम् ॥
1.70.m: He has no share in the plants, nor in the waters; / the sun does not come within his sight. / The earth hates him as he walks— / he who has incurred the sin of marrying a younger sister first.

1.70.s: trite devā amṛjataina etat trita enan manuṣyeṣv amṛṣṭa | tata etad amuyā rakṣa īrte pramuktaṃ jyoter adhi dūram eti ||
1.70.d: त्रिते देवा अमृजतैन एतत् त्रित एनन् मनुष्येष्व् अमृष्ट । तत एतद् अमुया रक्ष ईर्ते प्रमुक्तं ज्योतेर् अधि दूरम् एति ॥
1.70.m: The gods wiped this off onto Trita; / Trita wiped it off onto men; / thence the demon sets out yonder; / released, it goes far away from the light.

1.70.s: yebhiḥ pāśair didhiṣūpatir vibaddhaḥ parauparāv ārpito aṅgeaṅge | vi te cṛtyantāṃ vicṛto hi santi bhrūṇaghni pūṣan duritāni mṛṣṭā ||
1.70.d: येभिः पाशैर् दिधिषूपतिर् विबद्धः परौपराव् आर्पितो अङ्गेअङ्गे । वि ते चृत्यन्तां विचृतो हि सन्ति भ्रूणघ्नि पूषन् दुरितानि मृष्टा ॥
1.70.m: With whatever fetters the husband of the younger sister is bound, / fixed upon every limb, / let them be untied for you, for there are untiers; / O slayer of an embryo, O Pūṣan, [dispel] the misfortunes!

1.71.s: agniṣ ṭe viśa ā nayād indro vāyur bṛhaspatiḥ | sa te dharmam adīdharad dhāteva bhuvanebhyaḥ ||
1.71.d: अग्निष् टे विश आ नयाद् इन्द्रो वायुर् बृहस्पतिः । स ते धर्मम् अदीधरद् धातेव भुवनेभ्यः ॥
1.71.m: Let Agni bring you subjects, / Indra, Vāyu, Bṛhaspati! / He has upheld your order / like Dhātṛ for the worlds.

1.71.s: bṛhaspate puraetā viśām ihy agniḥ paścād abhi nudāty āyatīḥ | vāyur enā dakṣiṇataḥ pūṣottarād upānudāt ||
1.71.d: बृहस्पते पुरएता विशाम् इह्य् अग्निः पश्चाद् अभि नुदात्य् आयतीः । वायुर् एना दक्षिणतः पूषोत्तराद् उपानुदात् ॥
1.71.m: O Bṛhaspati, go as forerunner of the clans; / Agni from behind shall drive them as they come; / Vāyu shall drive them from the south, / Pūṣan from the north.

1.71.s: ā sahasrī śataratha ā revānyetu no viśam | endro vāmena viśpatir ā rūpeṇa bṛhaspatiḥ ||
1.71.d: आ सहस्री शतरथ आ रेवान्येतु नो विशम् । एन्द्रो वामेन विश्पतिर् आ रूपेण बृहस्पतिः ॥
1.71.m: Let the rich one possessing thousands, hundred-charioted, / come to our clan! / May Indra come as lord of the clan with lovely [wealth], / Bṛhaspati with form!

1.71.s: svarjuṣṭaḥ kaśyapasya sa rāṣṭre jāgarat sve | ṛṣabhaḥ śātamāturaḥ śvetantād avihruto devān yajñena bodhayāt ||
1.71.d: स्वर्जुष्टः कश्यपस्य स राष्ट्रे जागरत् स्वे । ऋषभः शातमातुरः श्वेतन्ताद् अविह्रुतो देवान् यज्ञेन बोधयात् ॥
1.71.m: Beloved of heaven, of Kaśyapa, / let him keep watch in his own kingdom! / The bull, offspring of a hundred mothers, / unswerving, / shall awaken the gods with sacrifice.

1.72.s: mahājanāḥ prathamā ye didīvire dhane saṃhatya mahati dvirāje | teṣāṃ vare yaḥ prathamo jigāya tasyāhaṃ lokam anūd bhideyam ||
1.72.d: महाजनाः प्रथमा ये दिदीविरे धने संहत्य महति द्विराजे । तेषां वरे यः प्रथमो जिगाय तस्याहं लोकम् अनूद् भिदेयम् ॥
1.72.m: The great men who were foremost, / banding together in the contest for two kings— / of them, he who won first in the choice: / his realm may I break into!

1.72.s: medinas te vaibhīdakās tata indra upāvatu | avyā vṛka iva saṃrabhya jigīvān astam āyasi ||
1.72.d: मेदिनस् ते वैभीदकास् तत इन्द्र उपावतु । अव्या वृक इव संरभ्य जिगीवान् अस्तम् आयसि ॥
1.72.m: Your allies are the Vibhīdaka dice; / from there let Indra assist you! / Clasping like a wolf among sheep, / you shall come home victorious.

1.72.s: udbāhū hiraṇyajid gojid aśvajitau bhare | vyāghro jaghnivām̐ iva ut tiṣṭhādhidevanāt ||
1.72.d: उद्बाहू हिरण्यजिद् गोजिद् अश्वजितौ भरे । व्याघ्रो जघ्निवाँ इव उत् तिष्ठाधिदेवनात् ॥
1.72.m: With upraised arms, winning gold, / winning cattle, winning horses in the contest! / Like a tiger that has slain [its prey], / arise from the gambling-place!

1.72.s: ādinavaṃ pratidīvne kṛtenāsmām̐ abhi kṣara | vṛkṣam ivāśanyā jahi yo asmān pratidīvyati ||
1.72.d: आदिनवं प्रतिदीव्ने कृतेनास्माँ अभि क्षर । वृक्षम् इवाशन्या जहि यो अस्मान् प्रतिदीव्यति ॥
1.72.m: Pour distress upon the rival player, / flow towards us with the Kṛta! / Strike down like a tree with a thunderbolt / the one who plays against us!

1.73.s: divas pṛthivyāḥ pary antarikṣād vanaspatibhyo adhy oṣadhībhyaḥ | yatrayatra vibhṛto jātavedās tatastato juṣamāṇo na ehi ||
1.73.d: दिवस् पृथिव्याः पर्य् अन्तरिक्षाद् वनस्पतिभ्यो अध्य् ओषधीभ्यः । यत्रयत्र विभृतो जातवेदास् ततस्ततो जुषमाणो न एहि ॥
1.73.m: From the sky, from the earth, from the intermediate space, / from the lords of the forest, from the plants: / wherever you are, O Jātavedas, / from there, being pleased, come to us!

1.73.s: yas te apsu mahimā yo vaneṣu ya oṣadhīṣu paśuṣv apsv antaḥ | agne sarvās tanvaḥ saṃ rabhasva tābhir na ehi draviṇodā ajasraḥ ||
1.73.d: यस् ते अप्सु महिमा यो वनेषु य ओषधीषु पशुष्व् अप्स्व् अन्तः । अग्ने सर्वास् तन्वः सं रभस्व ताभिर् न एहि द्रविणोदा अजस्रः ॥
1.73.m: Whatever greatness of yours is in the waters, what in the woods, / what in the plants, in the beasts, within the waters— / O Agni, gather all your bodies; / with them come to us as the unceasing bestower of wealth!

1.73.s: yas te deveṣu mahimā svargo yā te tanūḥ pitṛṣv āviveśa | puṣṭir yā te manuṣyeṣu paprathe 'gne tayā rayim asmāsu dhehi ||
1.73.d: यस् ते देवेषु महिमा स्वर्गो या ते तनूः पितृष्व् आविवेश । पुष्टिर् या ते मनुष्येषु पप्रथे ऽग्ने तया रयिम् अस्मासु धेहि ॥
1.73.m: Whatever heavenly greatness of yours is among the gods, / whatever body of yours entered into the ancestors, / whatever nourishment of yours spread abroad among men— / with that, O Agni, bestow wealth upon us!

1.73.s: śrutkarṇāya kavaye vedyāya vacobhir vākair upa yāmi rātim | yato bhayam abhayaṃ tan no astv ava devānāṃ yaja heḍo agne ||
1.73.d: श्रुत्कर्णाय कवये वेद्याय वचोभिर् वाकैर् उप यामि रातिम् । यतो भयम् अभयं तन् नो अस्त्व् अव देवानां यज हेडो अग्ने ॥
1.73.m: To the wise poet whose ears hear, who is to be known, / [we bring] bounty with words, with songs. / From what there is fear, let that be safety for us; / sacrifice away the anger of the gods, O Agni!

1.74.s: indro devānāṃ varuṇo dhṛtavrataḥ somo vīrudhāṃ jagataḥ paraspāḥ | vāyuḥ paśūnāṃ paśupā janānām ayaṃ purorā no asyāstu mūrdhā ||
1.74.d: इन्द्रो देवानां वरुणो धृतव्रतः सोमो वीरुधां जगतः परस्पाः । वायुः पशूनां पशुपा जनानाम् अयं पुरोरा नो अस्यास्तु मूर्धा ॥
1.74.m: Indra of the gods, Varuṇa of steadfast vows, / Soma of the plants, of the world, / Vāyu of beasts, protector of cattle among men— / may this our foremost ruler be our head!

1.74.s: mūrdhā divo antarikṣasya mūrdhā mūrdhā sindhūnām uta parvatānām | mūrdhā viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā ayaṃ purorā no asyāstu mūrdhā ||
1.74.d: मूर्धा दिवो अन्तरिक्षस्य मूर्धा मूर्धा सिन्धूनाम् उत पर्वतानाम् । मूर्धा विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा अयं पुरोरा नो अस्यास्तु मूर्धा ॥
1.74.m: Head of heaven, head of the intermediate space, / head of the rivers and of the mountains, / king, head of the whole world— / may this our foremost ruler be our head!

1.74.s: mṛdhas te samrāḍ ava hantu sarvām̐ amitrān rājā varuṇo viṣūcaḥ | indraḥ śatrūn asunītiṃ nayāti te 'yaṃ purorā no asyāstu mūrdhā ||
1.74.d: मृधस् ते सम्राड् अव हन्तु सर्वाँ अमित्रान् राजा वरुणो विषूचः । इन्द्रः शत्रून् असुनीतिं नयाति ते ऽयं पुरोरा नो अस्यास्तु मूर्धा ॥
1.74.m: May the sovereign strike down all your adversaries, / King Varuṇa [scatter] the enemies in all directions; / Indra shall lead your foes to death! / May this our foremost ruler be our head!

1.74.s: viśas tvā rājan pradiśo juṣantāṃ daivīr viśaḥ supraketāḥ saketāḥ | viśvā āśā manuṣyo vi bhāhy ayaṃ purorā no asyāstu mūrdhā ||
1.74.d: विशस् त्वा राजन् प्रदिशो जुषन्तां दैवीर् विशः सुप्रकेताः सकेताः । विश्वा आशा मनुष्यो वि भाह्य् अयं पुरोरा नो अस्यास्तु मूर्धा ॥
1.74.m: May the clans, O king, take pleasure in you, and the quarters, / the divine clans, clear-minded, of one accord! / Shine through all regions as a man; / may this our foremost ruler be our head!

1.75.s: vi bādhasva dṛṃhasva vīḍayasva adhaspadaṃ śatravas te bhavantu | sapatnasāha ṛṣabho janāṣāḍ ugraś cettā pañca kṛṣṭīr vi rāja ||
1.75.d: वि बाधस्व दृंहस्व वीडयस्व अधस्पदं शत्रवस् ते भवन्तु । सपत्नसाह ऋषभो जनाषाड् उग्रश् चेत्ता पञ्च कृष्टीर् वि राज ॥
1.75.m: Thrust away, stand firm; / let your enemies be beneath your feet! / Overcoming rivals, a bull conquering men, / fierce, observant, rule over the five peoples!

1.75.s: śivaṃ kṣetram anamīvaṃ te astu uttame nāke adhi tiṣṭhehi | putrān bhrātṝn bahulān paśyamāno viśve tvā devā iha dhārayantu ||
1.75.d: शिवं क्षेत्रम् अनमीवं ते अस्तु उत्तमे नाके अधि तिष्ठेहि । पुत्रान् भ्रातॄन् बहुलान् पश्यमानो विश्वे त्वा देवा इह धारयन्तु ॥
1.75.m: May your land be auspicious, free from disease; / ascend into the highest firmament! / Beholding abundant sons and brothers, / may all the gods uphold you here!

1.75.s: tvaṣṭā rūpeṇa savitā savena ahar mitreṇa varuṇena rātrī | indro jyaiṣṭhyena brahmaṇāyaṃ bṛhaspatir | dhātā tvā dhībhir abhi rakṣatv iha ||
1.75.d: त्वष्टा रूपेण सविता सवेन अहर् मित्रेण वरुणेन रात्री । इन्द्रो ज्यैष्ठ्येन ब्रह्मणायं बृहस्पतिर् । धाता त्वा धीभिर् अभि रक्षत्व् इह ॥
1.75.m: Tvaṣṭar with form, Savitar with instigation, / the nights with Mitra and Varuṇa, / Indra with supremacy, this Bṛhaspati with holy power, / may Dhātar protect you here with his thoughts!

1.75.s: vāstoṣpata iha naḥ śarma yaccha ghane vṛtrāṇāṃ saṃgathe vasūnām | ihaivaidhi grāmapatir janāṣāḍ viśvair devair gupito rakṣamāṇaḥ ||
1.75.d: वास्तोष्पत इह नः शर्म यच्छ घने वृत्राणां संगथे वसूनाम् । इहैवैधि ग्रामपतिर् जनाषाड् विश्वैर् देवैर् गुपितो रक्षमाणः ॥
1.75.m: O Lord of the Homestead, grant us shelter here / in the slaughter of foes, in the assembly of treasures! / Be right here the lord of the village, conquering men, / guarded by all the gods, being protected!

1.76.s: ūrdhvo bhava prati vidhyādhy asmad ugraṃ dhanur ojasvān ā tanuṣva | prati durhārdaṃ harasā śṛṇīhi kṛtvānam agne adharaṃ kṛṇuṣva ||
1.76.d: ऊर्ध्वो भव प्रति विध्याध्य् अस्मद् उग्रं धनुर् ओजस्वान् आ तनुष्व । प्रति दुर्हार्दं हरसा शृणीहि कृत्वानम् अग्ने अधरं कृणुष्व ॥
1.76.m: Stand upright, shoot back from us; / powerful, stretch your fierce bow! / Shatter the ill-hearted with your heat; / make the sorcerer lowest, O Agni!

1.76.s: praty enaṃ yāhi prati bhaṅdhy enaṃ vividhyann agne vitaraṃ vi bhāhi | pratyaṅ prehi vartmanā jarhṛṣāṇaḥ kṛtyākṛte duṣkṛte mādhi vocaḥ ||
1.76.d: प्रत्य् एनं याहि प्रति भङ्ध्य् एनं विविध्यन्न् अग्ने वितरं वि भाहि । प्रत्यङ् प्रेहि वर्त्मना जर्हृषाणः कृत्याकृते दुष्कृते माधि वोचः ॥
1.76.m: Go against him, break him down; / piercing through, O Agni, shine far and wide! / Go back along the track, rejoicing; / speak not in favor of the sorcerer, the evil-doer!

1.76.s: yo no durhārd dhṛdayenābhivaste yaś cakṣuṣā manasā yaś ca vācā | pratyaṅ daṃṣṭrābhyām abhi taṃ bubhūṣan kṛtyākṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ nir dahāgne ||
1.76.d: यो नो दुर्हार्द् धृदयेनाभिवस्ते यश् चक्षुषा मनसा यश् च वाचा । प्रत्यङ् दंष्ट्राभ्याम् अभि तं बुभूषन् कृत्याकृतं दुष्कृतं निर् दहाग्ने ॥
1.76.m: Whoever lies in wait for us in his heart, / who with his eye, with his mind, and who with his speech— / turning back upon him with your two fangs, / burn up that sorcerer, that evil-doer, O Agni!

1.76.s: pratībodhaś caturakṣo divyo aśmeva vīḍubhit | prabhañjañ chatrūn prati yāhy agne kṛtyākṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ hṛdaye vidhya marmaṇi ||
1.76.d: प्रतीबोधश् चतुरक्षो दिव्यो अश्मेव वीडुभित् । प्रभञ्जञ् छत्रून् प्रति याह्य् अग्ने कृत्याकृतं दुष्कृतं हृदये विध्य मर्मणि ॥
1.76.m: Awakening, four-eyed, / like a heavenly stone cleaving the stronghold, / crushing the foes, advance against [them], O Agni; / pierce the sorcerer, the evil-doer, in the heart, in the vital spot!

1.77.s: indra kṣatram abhi vāmam ojo 'jāyathā vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnām | apānudo janam amitrayantam uruṃ devebhyo akṛṇor ulokam ||
1.77.d: इन्द्र क्षत्रम् अभि वामम् ओजो ऽजायथा वृषभ चर्षणीनाम् । अपानुदो जनम् अमित्रयन्तम् उरुं देवेभ्यो अकृणोर् उलोकम् ॥
1.77.m: To dominion, to lovely power, O Indra, / you were born, the bull of the peoples! / You thrust away the hostile folk; / you made wide space for the gods!

1.77.s: mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ parāvata ā jagāmā parasyāḥ | sṛkaṃ saṃśāya pavim indra tigmaṃ vi śatrūn tāḍhi vi mṛdho nudasva ||
1.77.d: मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः परावत आ जगामा परस्याः । सृकं संशाय पविम् इन्द्र तिग्मं वि शत्रून् ताढि वि मृधो नुदस्व ॥
1.77.m: Like a dread beast, roaming about, dwelling in the mountains, / he has come from the farthest distance. / Having sharpened your dart, your sharp blade, O Indra, / thrust apart the enemies, thrust apart the adversaries!

1.77.s: aṃhomuce pra bhare manīṣām ā sutrāmṇe sumatim āvṛṇānaḥ | idam indra prati havyaṃ gṛbhāya satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ ||
1.77.d: अंहोमुचे प्र भरे मनीषाम् आ सुत्राम्णे सुमतिम् आवृणानः । इदम् इन्द्र प्रति हव्यं गृभाय सत्याः सन्तु यजमानस्य कामाः ॥
1.77.m: I offer my prayer to the Deliverer from Distress, / winning the good favor of the Good Protector. / Receive this offering, O Indra; / let the desires of the sacrificer be true!

1.77.s: aṃhomucaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yajñiyānāṃ virājantaṃ prathamam adhvarāṇām | apāṃ napātam aśvinau huve dhiya indriyeṇa na indriyaṃ dhattam ojaḥ ||
1.77.d: अंहोमुचं वृषभं यज्ञियानां विराजन्तं प्रथमम् अध्वराणाम् । अपां नपातम् अश्विनौ हुवे धिय इन्द्रियेण न इन्द्रियं धत्तम् ओजः ॥
1.77.m: The Deliverer from Distress, the bull of those worthy of sacrifice, / reigning as the first of ceremonies, / Apāṃ Napāt do I invoke with my thought; / with Indra-power grant us Indra-power and might!

1.78.s: dhātāram indraṃ savitāram ūtaye huve devām̐ amṛtān martyaḥ san | śreṣṭhe no vasavo dhatta dhāmni mā radhāma dviṣate mo arātaye ||
1.78.d: धातारम् इन्द्रं सवितारम् ऊतये हुवे देवाँ अमृतान् मर्त्यः सन् । श्रेष्ठे नो वसवो धत्त धाम्नि मा रधाम द्विषते मो अरातये ॥
1.78.m: Dhātar, Indra, Savitar for help / do I invoke, mortal as I am, the immortal gods. / Place us in the highest domain, O Vasus; / let us not be given over to the hater, nor to the niggard!

1.78.s: adhi bravītv adhivaktā na indro adhi bravītu savitā daivyena | svasti mitrāvaruṇā ca dhattāṃ rātriṃrātrim aharahaś ca devāḥ ||
1.78.d: अधि ब्रवीत्व् अधिवक्ता न इन्द्रो अधि ब्रवीतु सविता दैव्येन । स्वस्ति मित्रावरुणा च धत्तां रात्रिंरात्रिम् अहरहश् च देवाः ॥
1.78.m: May our champion Indra speak for us; / may Savitar speak with divine [power]; / and may Mitra and Varuṇa grant well-being, / night after night, and day after day, O gods!

1.78.s: adhi bravītu pṛthivī uta dyaur adhi bruvantu marutaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ | yo no dveṣṭy araṇo yaḥ sanābhiḥ pavir iva nemer adharaḥ so astu ||
1.78.d: अधि ब्रवीतु पृथिवी उत द्यौर् अधि ब्रुवन्तु मरुतः पृश्निमातरः । यो नो द्वेष्ट्य् अरणो यः सनाभिः पविर् इव नेमेर् अधरः सो अस्तु ॥
1.78.m: May Earth speak for us, and Heaven; / may the Maruts, whose mother is Pṛśni, speak! / He who hates us, whether stranger or kinsman, / let him be beneath us like the felly beneath the tire!

1.78.s: yasya trayā gatam anuprayanti devā manuṣyāḥ paśavaś ca sarve | tan no devaṃ mano adhi bravītu sunīti no nayatu dviṣate mā radhāma ||
1.78.d: यस्य त्रया गतम् अनुप्रयन्ति देवा मनुष्याः पशवश् च सर्वे । तन् नो देवं मनो अधि ब्रवीतु सुनीति नो नयतु द्विषते मा रधाम ॥
1.78.m: Whose course the three follow— / gods, men, and all cattle— / may that divine Mind speak for us; / let it lead us with good guidance; may we not be given over to the hater!

1.79.s: varcasvān asi deveṣu varcasvān oṣadhīṣv ā | atho varcasvinaṃ kṛdhi yam aśvatthādhirohasi ||
1.79.d: वर्चस्वान् असि देवेषु वर्चस्वान् ओषधीष्व् आ । अथो वर्चस्विनं कृधि यम् अश्वत्थाधिरोहसि ॥
1.79.m: Full of luster are you among the gods, / full of luster in the plants; / so make full of luster him / whom you ascend, O aśvattha!

1.79.s: yam aśvattho adhyarukṣad rājā manuṣyaṃ janam | indram iva vi mṛdho hanat tasmād rāṣṭram anapacyutam ||
1.79.d: यम् अश्वत्थो अध्यरुक्षद् राजा मनुष्यं जनम् । इन्द्रम् इव वि मृधो हनत् तस्माद् राष्ट्रम् अनपच्युतम् ॥
1.79.m: The human folk over whom the aśvattha has mounted, / the king— / like Indra he shall strike down adversaries; / from him the kingdom shall not fall away.

1.79.s: āroho nāma vā asi sahasvān ud ajāyathāḥ | taṃ tvā sapatnasāsaham aśvattha bibharād ayam ||
1.79.d: आरोहो नाम वा असि सहस्वान् उद् अजायथाः । तं त्वा सपत्नसासहम् अश्वत्थ बिभराद् अयम् ॥
1.79.m: ‘Ascender’ indeed is your name; / victorious did you arise. / As such, overcoming rivals, / let this [man] bear you, O aśvattha!

1.79.s: rājā vā asi bhūtānām ṛṣabho vīrudhāṃ patiḥ | sa naḥ sapatnān aśvattha viṣūco vy ud ā kṛdhi ||
1.79.d: राजा वा असि भूतानाम् ऋषभो वीरुधां पतिः । स नः सपत्नान् अश्वत्थ विषूचो व्य् उद् आ कृधि ॥
1.79.m: King indeed are you of beings, / bull, lord of plants. / As such, make our rivals, O aśvattha, / scatter apart in all directions!

1.80.s: saṃpaśyamānā amṛtāya āyan śuddhā yonibhyas pari jāyamānāḥ | śivaṃ kṛṇvānā upa jighratemaṃ vīraṃ vīreṣv apy ā kṛṇudhvam ||
1.80.d: संपश्यमाना अमृताय आयन् शुद्धा योनिभ्यस् परि जायमानाः । शिवं कृण्वाना उप जिघ्रतेमं वीरं वीरेष्व् अप्य् आ कृणुध्वम् ॥
1.80.m: Beholding, they came for immortality, / pure, being born from the wombs. / Making [him] auspicious, smell upon this one; / place the hero among heroes!

1.80.s: śivo vo vīra iha jāto astu śuddho yonibhyas pari jāyamānaḥ | ariṣṭo 'yaṃ vardhatāṃ sarvam āyur varma jyāyobhyo haviṣā kṛṇotu ||
1.80.d: शिवो वो वीर इह जातो अस्तु शुद्धो योनिभ्यस् परि जायमानः । अरिष्टो ऽयं वर्धतां सर्वम् आयुर् वर्म ज्यायोभ्यो हविषा कृणोतु ॥
1.80.m: May your hero born here be auspicious, / pure, being born from the wombs. / Uninjured may he grow for a full lifespan; / let him make an armor for his elders with an oblation!

1.80.s: jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ prepsatu jīva eṣa nāsya krimir īśāto nota jambhaḥ | saṃrabhya jīva śaradaḥ suvarcā agniṣ ṭe gopā adhipā vasiṣṭhaḥ ||
1.80.d: जरां मृत्युं प्रेप्सतु जीव एष नास्य क्रिमिर् ईशातो नोत जम्भः । संरभ्य जीव शरदः सुवर्चा अग्निष् टे गोपा अधिपा वसिष्ठः ॥
1.80.m: Let this living one reach old age as his death; / let no worm, no biting beast be his! / Clinging fast, live autumns, full of luster; / Agni is your herdsman, your best overlord!

1.80.s: jarāmṛtyur jarāyur jarācakṣur jarāsvaḥ | jarase tvā jaradaṣṭiṃ pari dadāmi ||
1.80.d: जरामृत्युर् जरायुर् जराचक्षुर् जरास्वः । जरसे त्वा जरदष्टिं परि ददामि ॥
1.80.m: Having old age as one's death, having old age as life, having old age as sight, having old age as property! / Unto old age do I commit you, reaching old age!

1.80.s: dyauṣ ṭe pitā pṛthivī mātāntarikṣam ātmā | vātaḥ prāṇaḥ sūryaś cakṣur divas payaḥ | suparṇas tvābhy ava paśyād āyuṣe varcase 'yam annasyānnapatir astu vīraḥ ||
1.80.d: द्यौष् टे पिता पृथिवी मातान्तरिक्षम् आत्मा । वातः प्राणः सूर्यश् चक्षुर् दिवस् पयः । सुपर्णस् त्वाभ्य् अव पश्याद् आयुषे वर्चसे ऽयम् अन्नस्यान्नपतिर् अस्तु वीरः ॥
1.80.m: Heaven is your father, Earth your mother, the atmosphere your breath-soul; / the wind is your breath, the sun your eye, the milk of heaven [your nourishment]. / May the eagle look down upon you for lifespan, for luster; / may this hero be the lord of food of food!

1.81.s: yajñasya cakṣuḥ prabhṛtir mukhaṃ ca vācā śrotreṇa manasā juhomi | imaṃ yajñaṃ vitataṃ viśvakarmaṇā ā devā yantu sumanasyamānāḥ ||
1.81.d: यज्ञस्य चक्षुः प्रभृतिर् मुखं च वाचा श्रोत्रेण मनसा जुहोमि । इमं यज्ञं विततं विश्वकर्मणा आ देवा यन्तु सुमनस्यमानाः ॥
1.81.m: The eye of the sacrifice, the presentation, and its mouth / do I offer with speech, with hearing, with mind. / To this sacrifice spread out by Viśvakarman / let the gods come, being well-disposed!

1.81.s: ye devānām ṛtvijo ye ca yajñiyā yebhyo havyaṃ kriyate bhāgadheyam | imaṃ yajñaṃ saha patnībhir etya yāvanto devās tati mādayantām ||
1.81.d: ये देवानाम् ऋत्विजो ये च यज्ञिया येभ्यो हव्यं क्रियते भागधेयम् । इमं यज्ञं सह पत्नीभिर् एत्य यावन्तो देवास् तति मादयन्ताम् ॥
1.81.m: Those who are the priests of the gods and those worthy of sacrifice, / for whom the oblation is made as their portion— / having come to this sacrifice together with their wives, / as many as are the gods, let them exhilarate themselves!

1.81.s: yan mā hutaṃ yad ahutam ājagāma yasmād annān manasodrārajīmi | yad devānāṃ cakṣuṣa āgasīnam agniṣ ṭad dhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu ||
1.81.d: यन् मा हुतं यद् अहुतम् आजगाम यस्माद् अन्नान् मनसोद्रारजीमि । यद् देवानां चक्षुष आगसीनम् अग्निष् टद् धोता सुहुतं कृणोतु ॥
1.81.m: What of mine came offered, what unoffered, / from whatever food I tremble in mind, / what was an offense before the eye of the gods, / let Agni the Hotar make that well-offered!

1.81.s: agneṣ ṭvā jihvayā hutam iṣṭaṃ marudbhir anumataṃ pitṛbhiḥ prāśnāmi ||
1.81.d: अग्नेष् ट्वा जिह्वया हुतम् इष्टं मरुद्भिर् अनुमतं पितृभिः प्राश्नामि ॥
1.81.m: Offered with the tongue of Agni, sacrificed, agreed to by the Maruts, / approved by the Fathers, do I eat you!

1.82.s: agneḥ prajātaṃ pari yad dhiraṇyam amṛtaṃ dadhre adhi martyeṣu | ya enad veda sa id enad arhati jarāmṛtyur bhavati yo bibharti ||
1.82.d: अग्नेः प्रजातं परि यद् धिरण्यम् अमृतं दध्रे अधि मर्त्येषु । य एनद् वेद स इद् एनद् अर्हति जरामृत्युर् भवति यो बिभर्ति ॥
1.82.m: The gold that was born from Agni, / immortal, was placed among mortals; / he who knows it, he alone deserves it; / he who wears it becomes one who has old age as his death.

1.82.s: yad dhiraṇyaṃ sūryeṇa suvarṇaṃ prajāvanto manavaḥ pūrva īṣire | tat tvā candraṃ varcasā saṃ sṛjāty āyuṣmān bhavati yo bibharti ||
1.82.d: यद् धिरण्यं सूर्येण सुवर्णं प्रजावन्तो मनवः पूर्व ईषिरे । तत् त्वा चन्द्रं वर्चसा सं सृजात्य् आयुष्मान् भवति यो बिभर्ति ॥
1.82.m: The gold, fair-colored with the sun, / which the ancient Manus possessing offspring sought— / that shining [metal] shall unite you with luster; / long-lived becomes he who wears it.

1.82.s: āyuṣe tvā varcase tvā ojase ca balāya ca | yathā hiraṇya tejasā vibhāsāsi janām̐ anu ||
1.82.d: आयुषे त्वा वर्चसे त्वा ओजसे च बलाय च । यथा हिरण्य तेजसा विभासासि जनाँ अनु ॥
1.82.m: For lifespan [I bind] you, for luster [I bind] you, / and for might, and for strength, / so that, O gold, with brilliance / you shall shine out among the peoples!

1.82.s: yad veda rājā varuṇo veda devo bṛhaspatiḥ | indro yad vṛtrahā veda tat ta āyuṣyaṃ bhuvat tat te varcasyaṃ bhuvat ||
1.82.d: यद् वेद राजा वरुणो वेद देवो बृहस्पतिः । इन्द्रो यद् वृत्रहा वेद तत् त आयुष्यं भुवत् तत् ते वर्चस्यं भुवत् ॥
1.82.m: What King Varuṇa knows, / what god Bṛhaspati knows, / what Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, knows— / may that be life-giving for you, / may that be luster-giving for you!

1.83.s: yad ābadhnan dākṣāyaṇā hiraṇyaṃ śatānīkāya sumanasyamānāḥ | tat te badhnāmi śataśāradāya āyuṣmān jaradaṣṭir yathāsaḥ ||
1.83.d: यद् आबध्नन् दाक्षायणा हिरण्यं शतानीकाय सुमनस्यमानाः । तत् ते बध्नामि शतशारदाय आयुष्मान् जरदष्टिर् यथासः ॥
1.83.m: The gold which the descendants of Dakṣa bound on, / well-disposed toward him of a hundred troops— / that I bind on you for a hundred autumns, / so that you may be long-lived, reaching old age!

1.83.s: nainaṃ rakṣāṃsi na piśācāḥ sahante devānām ojaḥ prathamajaṃ hy etat | yo bibharti dākṣāyaṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ sa jīveṣu kṛṇute dīrgham āyuḥ ||
1.83.d: नैनं रक्षांसि न पिशाचाः सहन्ते देवानाम् ओजः प्रथमजं ह्य् एतत् । यो बिभर्ति दाक्षायणं हिरण्यं स जीवेषु कृणुते दीर्घम् आयुः ॥
1.83.m: Neither the rakṣases nor the piśācas overcome him, / for this is the first-born might of the gods. / He who wears gold / creates for himself a long lifespan among the living.

1.83.s: apāṃ reto jyotir ojo balaṃ ca vanaspatīnām uta vīryāṇi | indra ivendriyam ava rudhmo asmin sa dakṣamāṇo bibharad dhiraṇyam ||
1.83.d: अपां रेतो ज्योतिर् ओजो बलं च वनस्पतीनाम् उत वीर्याणि । इन्द्र इवेन्द्रियम् अव रुध्मो अस्मिन् स दक्षमाणो बिभरद् धिरण्यम् ॥
1.83.m: The seed of the waters, light, might, and strength, / and the virile powers of the trees of the forest— / like Indra, we enclose Indra-power within him; / showing ability, let him wear gold!

1.83.s: samānāṃ māsām ṛtubhiṣ ṭvāhaṃ saṃvatsarasya payasā piparmi | indrāgnī tvā brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānāv āyuṣmantam uttamaṃ tvā karātaḥ ||
1.83.d: समानां मासाम् ऋतुभिष् ट्वाहं संवत्सरस्य पयसा पिपर्मि । इन्द्राग्नी त्वा ब्रह्मणा वावृधानाव् आयुष्मन्तम् उत्तमं त्वा करातः ॥
1.83.m: Together with the seasons of the months / do I bring you safely through with the milk of the year. / May Indra and Agni, strengthened by holy power, / make you long-lived and highest!

1.84.s: yat te catasraḥ pradiśo mano jagāma dūrakam | tat ta ā vartayāmasi iha kṣayāya jīvase ||
1.84.d: यत् ते चतस्रः प्रदिशो मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत् त आ वर्तयामसि इह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
1.84.m: What mind of yours has gone far away / to the four quarters— / that we turn back to you, / to dwell here, to live!
What mind of yours to the four-cornered earth […]
What mind of yours to Yama, son of Vivasvat […]
What mind of yours [has gone] to the surging ocean […]

1.84.s: yat te divaṃ yat pṛthivīṃ manaḥ … ||
1.84.d: यत् ते दिवं यत् पृथिवीं मनः … ॥
1.84.m: What mind of yours [has gone] to heaven, what to earth […]
What mind of yours [has gone] to the wind, to the intermediate space […]

1.84.s: yat te sūryaṃ yad uṣasaṃ manaḥ … ||
1.84.d: यत् ते सूर्यं यद् उषसं मनः … ॥
1.84.m: What mind of yours [has gone] to the sun, what to the dawn […]
What mind of yours [has gone] to the moon, to the constellations […]

1.84.s: yat ta āpo yad oṣadhīr manaḥ … ||
1.84.d: यत् त आपो यद् ओषधीर् मनः … ॥
1.84.m: What mind of yours [has gone] to the waters, what to the plants […]

1.84.s: yat te parāṃ parāvataṃ mano jagāma dūrakam | tat ta ā vartayāmasi iha kṣayāya jīvase ||
1.84.d: यत् ते परां परावतं मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत् त आ वर्तयामसि इह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
1.84.m: What mind of yours has gone far away / to the furthest distance— / that we turn back to you, / to dwell here, to live!

1.85.s: yaṃ gṛhṇanty apsaraso yaṃ mathnāti bṛhaspatiḥ | taṃ kaśyapasya brahmaṇā savitā punar ā bharat ||
1.85.d: यं गृह्णन्त्य् अप्सरसो यं मथ्नाति बृहस्पतिः । तं कश्यपस्य ब्रह्मणा सविता पुनर् आ भरत् ॥
1.85.m: Whom the Apsarases seize, / whom Bṛhaspati torments— / him Savitṛ has brought back / by the sacred formulation of Kaśyapa.

1.85.s: yo bhartākūḥ paridhāya mṛgeṣv api dhāvati | taṃ kaśyapasya brahmaṇā savitā punar ā bharat ||
1.85.d: यो भर्ताकूः परिधाय मृगेष्व् अपि धावति । तं कश्यपस्य ब्रह्मणा सविता पुनर् आ भरत् ॥
1.85.m: Who, putting on […], / runs even among the wild beasts— / him Savitṛ has brought back / by the sacred formulation of Kaśyapa.

1.85.s: savitāgnir brahmā soma indras tvaṣṭā bṛhaspatiḥ | ete marudyutaṃ tvā brahmaṇā punar ā bharan ||
1.85.d: सविताग्निर् ब्रह्मा सोम इन्द्रस् त्वष्टा बृहस्पतिः । एते मरुद्युतं त्वा ब्रह्मणा पुनर् आ भरन् ॥
1.85.m: Savitṛ, Agni, Soma, / Indra, Tvaṣṭṛ, Bṛhaspati— / these have brought you back, shining with the Maruts, / by the sacred formulation.

1.85.s: bhadrāṃ vācaṃ śivaṃ cakṣur marudyutāya kṛṇmasi | imāṃ hy asmā oṣadhim ā harāmy arundhatīm ||
1.85.d: भद्रां वाचं शिवं चक्षुर् मरुद्युताय कृण्मसि । इमां ह्य् अस्मा ओषधिम् आ हराम्य् अरुन्धतीम् ॥
1.85.m: Auspicious speech, a propitious eye / we make for [you] who shine with the Maruts; / for him I now bring here / the Arundhatī plant.

1.86.s: tribhyo rudrebhyaḥ pravasan yajāmi jyeṣṭhaḥ kaniṣṭha uta madhyamo yaḥ | jyotiṣkārāḥ kavayaḥ somapā ye kaṇvā ajantu nir ito vadhena ||
1.86.d: त्रिभ्यो रुद्रेभ्यः प्रवसन् यजामि ज्येष्ठः कनिष्ठ उत मध्यमो यः । ज्योतिष्काराः कवयः सोमपा ये कण्वा अजन्तु निर् इतो वधेन ॥
1.86.m: Going abroad, I sacrifice to the three Rudras: / he who is oldest, he who is youngest, and he who is intermediate. / The seers who make light, who drink Soma— / let them drive the Kaṇvas out from here with a weapon!

1.86.s: indrāgnī vītaṃ haviṣaḥ saṃvidānau samiddho agniḥ samidhā gīrbhir indraḥ | nudethāṃ kaṇvā nir ito arātim ārād rakṣāṃsi tapataṃ vy asmat ||
1.86.d: इन्द्राग्नी वीतं हविषः संविदानौ समिद्धो अग्निः समिधा गीर्भिर् इन्द्रः । नुदेथां कण्वा निर् इतो अरातिम् आराद् रक्षांसि तपतं व्य् अस्मत् ॥
1.86.m: O Indra and Agni, partake of the oblation in agreement! / Agni is kindled with firewood, Indra with songs. / Drive out the Kaṇvas from here, [and] the enemy; / burn away the demons far from us!

1.86.s: vāstoṣpate suprajasaḥ suvīrā ṣaṣṭhīsyāmi śaradaḥ śatāni | durvāstu kaṇvā abhi nir ṇudasva suvāstv asmām̐ upa saṃ viśasva ||
1.86.d: वास्तोष्पते सुप्रजसः सुवीरा षष्ठीस्यामि शरदः शतानि । दुर्वास्तु कण्वा अभि निर् णुदस्व सुवास्त्व् अस्माँ उप सं विशस्व ॥
1.86.m: O Lord of the Homestead, [may we have] good offspring, good heroes, / [living for] a hundred autumns! / Drive out the Kaṇvas to bad homesteads; / enter into us, [bringing] a good homestead!

1.86.s: yā tantiṣat khalasad yā ca goṣṭhe yā jātāḥ śakadhūme sabhāyām | prapāyāṃ jātā uta yāś ca bhitsu tāś cātayāmaḥ śivatā no astu ||
1.86.d: या तन्तिषत् खलसद् या च गोष्ठे या जाताः शकधूमे सभायाम् । प्रपायां जाता उत याश् च भित्सु ताश् चातयामः शिवता नो अस्तु ॥
1.86.m: Those that dwell in the calf-rope, those that dwell in the threshing-floor, and those in the cow-pen, / those that are born in the dung-smoke, in the assembly, / and those born at the watering-trough, and those in the walls— / these we drive away: let there be auspiciousness for us!

1.86.s: dudvā ca dudvatī ca sthas tad vāṃ nāma tad vāṃ nāmadheyam | rudrapreṣite stho 'vye nāma pary asmān vṛṅktam | yo no dveṣṭi tam ṛcchatam ||
1.86.d: दुद्वा च दुद्वती च स्थस् तद् वां नाम तद् वां नामधेयम् । रुद्रप्रेषिते स्थो ऽव्ये नाम पर्य् अस्मान् वृङ्क्तम् । यो नो द्वेष्टि तम् ऋच्छतम् ॥
1.86.m: You two are Dudvā and Dudvatī; / that is your name, that is your designation. / You are dispatched by Rudra; you are called Avyā. / Turn away around us! / Fall upon him who hates us!

1.86.s: vīcī nāmāsy aghahārā nāma | namas te astu vātake 'nyatrāsmad aghaṃ kṛdhi ||
1.86.d: वीची नामास्य् अघहारा नाम । नमस् ते अस्तु वातके ऽन्यत्रास्मद् अघं कृधि ॥
1.86.m: Vīcī is your name, Destroyer of Evil is your name. / Homage be to you, O Vātakā! / Make the evil [go] elsewhere than to us!

1.86.s: ṛjīte pari ṇo nama agreṇa pari ṇo nama | aśmānaṃ tanvaṃ kṛṇmahe adyā naḥ soma mṛḍaya ||
1.86.d: ऋजीते परि णो नम अग्रेण परि णो नम । अश्मानं तन्वं कृण्महे अद्या नः सोम मृडय ॥
1.86.m: O Ṛjīti, turn around us! / Turn around us in front! / We make our body a stone; / be gracious to us today, O Soma!

1.87.s: tvaṃ darbhāsi patir oṣadhīnāṃ vibhindan yāsi kanyā ivainām | bhindhi śiraḥ kṛmer jāyānyasya śarīraṃ bhindhy uta bhindhy asthi ||
1.87.d: त्वं दर्भासि पतिर् ओषधीनां विभिन्दन् यासि कन्या इवैनाम् । भिन्धि शिरः कृमेर् जायान्यस्य शरीरं भिन्ध्य् उत भिन्ध्य् अस्थि ॥
1.87.m: You are Darbha, lord of the plants; / splitting [disease] apart, you go like [a youth] to maiden[s]. / The head of the worm, of the Jāyānya, / the body and the bone […].

1.87.s: yaḥ kīkasāstho viradāt parūṃṣi yasyoddhāra uṣṇihās tā hi vavre | haniṣyāmi vāṃ nir ataḥ paretaṃ tṛṇāny attam avasīriṇām iva ||
1.87.d: यः कीकसास्थो विरदात् परूंषि यस्योद्धार उष्णिहास् ता हि वव्रे । हनिष्यामि वां निर् अतः परेतं तृणान्य् अत्तम् अवसीरिणाम् इव ॥
1.87.m: Which, seated in the breast-bones, gnaws at the joints, / whose removal is the neck-sinews—for it has chosen them— / I will slay you two: go away out from here! / Eat grasses, like [cows] wandering down!

1.87.s: ayaṃ ya āste jaṭhareṣv antaḥ kāsphīvaśaṃ nirajaṃ martyasya | haniṣyāmi vāṃ nir ataḥ paretaṃ stāyad eyathuḥ prati vām abhutsi ||
1.87.d: अयं य आस्ते जठरेष्व् अन्तः कास्फीवशं निरजं मर्त्यस्य । हनिष्यामि वां निर् अतः परेतं स्तायद् एयथुः प्रति वाम् अभुत्सि ॥
1.87.m: This which sits within the bellies / of the mortal— / I will slay you two: go away out from here! / Stealthily you two came: I have noticed you!

1.87.s: yeneyathus tena pathā paretaṃ stāyad eyathuḥ prati vām abhutsi | brahmaṇā vāṃ paritṛhya samantaṃ vi cchetsyāmi nakula iva sarpam ||
1.87.d: येनेयथुस् तेन पथा परेतं स्तायद् एयथुः प्रति वाम् अभुत्सि । ब्रह्मणा वां परितृह्य समन्तं वि च्छेत्स्यामि नकुल इव सर्पम् ॥
1.87.m: By the path by which you came, by that go away! / Stealthily you two came: I have noticed you! / Having encircled you all around with the sacred formulation, / I will cut you to pieces, as a mongoose a snake.

1.88.s: yajñapatim ṛṣaya enasāhur nirbhaktā bhāgād anutapyamānāḥ | yad enaś cakṛvān baddha eṣa tato viśvakarman pra mumugdhy enam ||
1.88.d: यज्ञपतिम् ऋषय एनसाहुर् निर्भक्ता भागाद् अनुतप्यमानाः । यद् एनश् चकृवान् बद्ध एष ततो विश्वकर्मन् प्र मुमुग्ध्य् एनम् ॥
1.88.m: The ṛṣis say that the lord of the sacrifice has sinned, / [when they are] excluded from their share, burning with regret. / What sin he has committed, [whereby] he is bound, / release him from that, O Viśvakarman!

1.88.s: adānyān somapān manyamāno yajñasya vidvān samaye na dhīraḥ | madhavyān stokān apa yān rarādha saṃ mā taiḥ sṛjatu viśvakarmā ||
1.88.d: अदान्यान् सोमपान् मन्यमानो यज्ञस्य विद्वान् समये न धीरः । मधव्यान् स्तोकान् अप यान् रराध सं मा तैः सृजतु विश्वकर्मा ॥
1.88.m: Deeming those who drink Soma to be ungenerous, / knowing the sacrifice, not wise at the [proper] time— / the sweet drops that he has withheld, / may Viśvakarman unite me with them!

1.88.s: ye bhakṣayanto na vasūny ānṛdhur yān agnayo anvatapyanta dhiṣṇyāḥ | yā teṣām avayā duriṣṭāt sviṣṭaṃ tad viśvakarmā kṛṇotu ||
1.88.d: ये भक्षयन्तो न वसून्य् आनृधुर् यान् अग्नयो अन्वतप्यन्त धिष्ण्याः । या तेषाम् अवया दुरिष्टात् स्विष्टं तद् विश्वकर्मा कृणोतु ॥
1.88.m: They who, while consuming [the oblations], did not thrive in wealth, / whom the fires burned with regret— / whatever expiation is theirs from bad sacrifice, / let Viśvakarman make that well-sacrificed!

1.88.s: bhīmā ṛṣayo namo astv ebhyaś cakṣur yad eṣāṃ manasaś ca saṃdṛk | bṛhaspataye mahiṣāya dive namo viśvakarman namas te pāhy asmān ||
1.88.d: भीमा ऋषयो नमो अस्त्व् एभ्यश् चक्षुर् यद् एषां मनसश् च संदृक् । बृहस्पतये महिषाय दिवे नमो विश्वकर्मन् नमस् ते पाह्य् अस्मान् ॥
1.88.m: Dreadful are the ṛṣis: homage be to them, / whose eye and vision is of the mind! / Homage to Bṛhaspati, the buffalo, to heaven! / O Viśvakarman, homage to you: protect us!

1.89.s: sarvā imā oṣadhayaḥ pṛthivyām adhi niṣṭhitāḥ | athaiva bhadrike tvam asurebhyo ajāyathāḥ ||
1.89.d: सर्वा इमा ओषधयः पृथिव्याम् अधि निष्ठिताः । अथैव भद्रिके त्वम् असुरेभ्यो अजायथाः ॥
1.89.m: All these plants / are established upon the earth. / Just so, O auspicious one, / were you born from the asuras.

1.89.s: śataṃ jahy apsarasāṃ śataṃ śvanvatīnām | gandharvapatnīnāṃ śatasya indro api kṛtac chiraḥ ||
1.89.d: शतं जह्य् अप्सरसां शतं श्वन्वतीनाम् । गन्धर्वपत्नीनां शतस्य इन्द्रो अपि कृतच् छिरः ॥
1.89.m: Slay a hundred of the Apsarases, / a hundred of those accompanied by dogs! / Of a hundred wives of the Gandharvas / Indra has cut off the head!

1.89.s: yāḥ patanti puro vātaṃ patanti reṣmabhiḥ saha | cetantīm aśmalāṃ palām indro apsaraso hanat ||
1.89.d: याः पतन्ति पुरो वातं पतन्ति रेष्मभिः सह । चेतन्तीम् अश्मलां पलाम् इन्द्रो अप्सरसो हनत् ॥
1.89.m: Those who fly before the wind, / who fly together with the storm-winds— / the observant, stony, gray / Apsarases let Indra slay!

1.89.s: vi vo yaśo havāmahe vi vo haviṣyam odanam | apāvarīr aporṇuta asmad yakṣmam aporṇuta vātas tejanyaṃ yathā ||
1.89.d: वि वो यशो हवामहे वि वो हविष्यम् ओदनम् । अपावरीर् अपोर्णुत अस्मद् यक्ष्मम् अपोर्णुत वातस् तेजन्यं यथा ॥
1.89.m: We take away your glory, / we take away your sacrificial porridge! / Uncovering ones, uncover— / uncover consumption from us, / as the wind [uncovers] the arrow-reed!

1.90.s: asitasya vidradhasya lohitasya vanaspate | visalpakasyauṣadhe moc chiṣaḥ piśitaṃ cana ||
1.90.d: असितस्य विद्रधस्य लोहितस्य वनस्पते । विसल्पकस्यौषधे मोच् छिषः पिशितं चन ॥
1.90.m: Of the dark abscess, / of the red, O tree— / of the spreading [eruption], O plant, / leave not even flesh behind!

1.90.s: yat te balāsa tiṣṭhataḥ kakṣe muṣkāv apākṛtam | vedāhaṃ tasya bheṣajaṃ cīpadrām abhicakṣaṇam ||
1.90.d: यत् ते बलास तिष्ठतः कक्षे मुष्काव् अपाकृतम् । वेदाहं तस्य भेषजं चीपद्राम् अभिचक्षणम् ॥
1.90.m: What balāsa you have standing / in the armpit, [what] has removed the testicles— / I know the medicine for it: / Cīpadrā, the surveyor.

1.90.s: nir balāsaṃ balāsino visalpam uta vidradham | paropahatyāṃ te vayaṃ parā yakṣmaṃ suvāmasi ||
1.90.d: निर् बलासं बलासिनो विसल्पम् उत विद्रधम् । परोपहत्यां ते वयं परा यक्ष्मं सुवामसि ॥
1.90.m: Out the balāsa from the one having balāsa, / the spreading [eruption] and the abscess— / your injury from afar, / consumption we drive far away.

1.90.s: śīrṣarogam aṅgarogaṃ śuktivalgaṃ vilohitam | parā te ajñātaṃ yakṣmam adharāñcaṃ suvāmasi ||
1.90.d: शीर्षरोगम् अङ्गरोगं शुक्तिवल्गं विलोहितम् । परा ते अज्ञातं यक्ष्मम् अधराञ्चं सुवामसि ॥
1.90.m: Head-disease, limb-disease, / the oyster-scale, the deep red [eruption]— / your unknown consumption / we drive downward.

1.91.s: payo deveṣu paya oṣadhīṣu paya āśāsu payo 'ntarikṣe | tan me dhātā savitā ca dhattāṃ viśve tad devā abhi saṃ gṛṇantu ||
1.91.d: पयो देवेषु पय ओषधीषु पय आशासु पयो ऽन्तरिक्षे । तन् मे धाता सविता च धत्तां विश्वे तद् देवा अभि सं गृणन्तु ॥
1.91.m: The milk in the gods, the milk in the plants, / the milk in the quarters, the milk in the intermediate space— / let Dhātṛ and Savitṛ bestow that upon me; / let the All-Gods approve that together!

1.91.s: payo yad apsu paya usriyāsu paya utseṣūta parvateṣu | tan me dhātā savitā ca dhattāṃ viśve tad devā abhi saṃ gṛṇantu ||
1.91.d: पयो यद् अप्सु पय उस्रियासु पय उत्सेषूत पर्वतेषु । तन् मे धाता सविता च धत्तां विश्वे तद् देवा अभि सं गृणन्तु ॥
1.91.m: The milk that is in the waters, the milk in the reddish cows, / the milk in the fountains and in the mountains— / let Dhātṛ and Savitṛ bestow that upon me; / let the All-Gods approve that together!

1.91.s: yan mṛgeṣu paya āviṣṭam asti yad ejati patati yat patatriṣu | tan me dhātā savitā ca dhattāṃ viśve tad devā abhi saṃ gṛṇantu ||
1.91.d: यन् मृगेषु पय आविष्टम् अस्ति यद् एजति पतति यत् पतत्रिषु । तन् मे धाता सविता च धत्तां विश्वे तद् देवा अभि सं गृणन्तु ॥
1.91.m: The milk that has entered into the wild beasts, / that moves, that flies, that is in winged creatures— / let Dhātṛ and Savitṛ bestow that upon me; / let the All-Gods approve that together!

1.91.s: yāni payāṃsi divy ārpitāni yāny antarikṣe bahudhā bahūni | teṣām īśāne vaśinī no adya pra dattāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ahṛṇīyamāne ||
1.91.d: यानि पयांसि दिव्य् आर्पितानि यान्य् अन्तरिक्षे बहुधा बहूनि । तेषाम् ईशाने वशिनी नो अद्य प्र दत्तां द्यावापृथिवी अहृणीयमाने ॥
1.91.m: What milks are placed in heaven, / what many [milks] in many ways in the intermediate space— / ruling over them, having mastery, / let Heaven and Earth, without anger, give them to us today!

1.92.s: āganmemāṃ samitiṃ viśvarūpāṃ yasyāṃ pūrvam avadad deva ekaḥ | sā naḥ sūktair jujuṣāṇā samīcy asmān vṛṇītāṃ sumanasyamānā ||
1.92.d: आगन्मेमां समितिं विश्वरूपां यस्यां पूर्वम् अवदद् देव एकः । सा नः सूक्तैर् जुजुषाणा समीच्य् अस्मान् वृणीतां सुमनस्यमाना ॥
1.92.m: We have come to this all-formed assembly, / in which one god spoke previously. / Enjoying our well-spoken [hymns], united, / well-disposed, let it choose us!

1.92.s: iyaṃ devī samitir viśvarūpā śilpaṃ kṛṇvānā carati janeṣu | tāṃ rājānaḥ kavayo hṛtsu ketair arājānaś ca vadanaiḥ punanti ||
1.92.d: इयं देवी समितिर् विश्वरूपा शिल्पं कृण्वाना चरति जनेषु । तां राजानः कवयो हृत्सु केतैर् अराजानश् च वदनैः पुनन्ति ॥
1.92.m: This divine assembly, all-formed, / performing artistic work, moves among the people. / Kings and seers purify it in their hearts with their insights, / and non-kings with their speeches.

1.92.s: agniṃ sāmityam upa saṃ sadema vācā priyaṃ madhumatyā vadantaḥ | somo rājā varuṇo mitradharmā mayi śremāṇam upa saṃ namantu ||
1.92.d: अग्निं सामित्यम् उप सं सदेम वाचा प्रियं मधुमत्या वदन्तः । सोमो राजा वरुणो मित्रधर्मा मयि श्रेमाणम् उप सं नमन्तु ॥
1.92.m: May we sit together near Agni belonging to the assembly, / speaking what is dear with honeyed voice. / King Soma, Varuṇa of friendly law— / let them bend toward me!

1.92.s: yo vaḥ śuṣmo hṛdaye yo bāhvor yaś ca cakṣuṣi | jihvāyā agre yo manyus taṃ vo vi nayāmasi ||
1.92.d: यो वः शुष्मो हृदये यो बाह्वोर् यश् च चक्षुषि । जिह्वाया अग्रे यो मन्युस् तं वो वि नयामसि ॥
1.92.m: What fury of yours is in the heart, / what in the arms and what in the eye, / what rage is at the tip of the tongue— / that of yours we take away!

1.93.s: triṣ kuṣṭhāsi vṛtrāj jātas trir divas pari jajñiṣe | triḥ somāj jajñiṣe tvaṃ trir ādityebhyas pari ||
1.93.d: त्रिष् कुष्ठासि वृत्राज् जातस् त्रिर् दिवस् परि जज्ञिषे । त्रिः सोमाज् जज्ञिषे त्वं त्रिर् आदित्येभ्यस् परि ॥
1.93.m: Thrice, O Kuṣṭha, were you born from Vṛtra, / thrice from heaven; / thrice were you born from Soma, / thrice from the Ādityas.

1.93.s: jīvalaṃ naghāriṣaṃ jayatkam aparājitam | taṃ tvāmṛtasyeśānaṃ rājan kuṣṭhā vadāmasi ||
1.93.d: जीवलं नघारिषं जयत्कम् अपराजितम् । तं त्वामृतस्येशानं राजन् कुष्ठा वदामसि ॥
1.93.m: Giving life, not harming, / victorious, unvanquished— / as such, lord of immortality, / we address you, O King Kuṣṭha!

1.93.s: antarā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣam idaṃ mahat | tatrāmṛtasyeśānaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ devā abadhnata ||
1.93.d: अन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षम् इदं महत् । तत्रामृतस्येशानं कुष्ठं देवा अबध्नत ॥
1.93.m: Between heaven and earth / is this great intermediate space; / there the gods bound Kuṣṭha, / the lord of immortality.

1.93.s: kuṣṭho 'si devakṛto himavadbhyo nirābhṛtaḥ | tīkṣṇābhir abhribhiḥ khātaḥ sa cakarthārasaṃ viṣam ||
1.93.d: कुष्ठो ऽसि देवकृतो हिमवद्भ्यो निराभृतः । तीक्ष्णाभिर् अभ्रिभिः खातः स चकर्थारसं विषम् ॥
1.93.m: You are Kuṣṭha, made by the gods, / brought down from the snowy mountains. / Dug with sharp spades, / you have made the poison sapless.

1.94.s: yās te śataṃ dhamanayaḥ sahasrāṇī ca viṃśatiḥ | babhror aśvasya vāreṇa api nahyāmi tā aham ||
1.94.d: यास् ते शतं धमनयः सहस्राणी च विंशतिः । बभ्रोर् अश्वस्य वारेण अपि नह्यामि ता अहम् ॥
1.94.m: The hundred channels that are yours, / and the twenty thousands— / with a hair of a brown horse / I close them up.

1.94.s: śatasya te dhamanīnāṃ sahasrasyāyutasya ca | dṛteḥ pādam iva sārathir api nahyāmi yad bilam ||
1.94.d: शतस्य ते धमनीनां सहस्रस्यायुतस्य च । दृतेः पादम् इव सारथिर् अपि नह्यामि यद् बिलम् ॥
1.94.m: Of your hundred channels, / of the thousand and of the ten thousand— / as a charioteer [shuts] the opening of a waterskin, / so I shut up the orifice.

1.94.s: paramasyāṃ parāvati śuṣko bhaṇḍuś ca tiṣṭhataḥ | tataḥ śuṣkasya śuṣmeṇa tiṣṭhantu lohinīr apaḥ ||
1.94.d: परमस्यां परावति शुष्को भण्डुश् च तिष्ठतः । ततः शुष्कस्य शुष्मेण तिष्ठन्तु लोहिनीर् अपः ॥
1.94.m: In the farthest distance / stand the Dry and the Bald. / Thence, by the strength of the Dry, / let the red waters stand still.

1.94.s: pari vaḥ sikatāmayaṃ maruṃ bile vapāmasi | yakac cid asravīt purā takac cid aśamīd idam ||
1.94.d: परि वः सिकतामयं मरुं बिले वपामसि । यकच् चिद् अस्रवीत् पुरा तकच् चिद् अशमीद् इदम् ॥
1.94.m: Around you we strew / a sandy desert in the opening. / […] formerly flowed; / […] this has been quieted.

1.95.s: rudra mā tvā jīhiḍāma suṣṭutyā maghavan mā sahūtyā | bhiṣaktamaṃ tvā bhiṣajāṃ śṛṇomy un no vīrām̐ īraya bheṣajebhiḥ ||
1.95.d: रुद्र मा त्वा जीहिडाम सुष्टुत्या मघवन् मा सहूत्या । भिषक्तमं त्वा भिषजां शृणोम्य् उन् नो वीराँ ईरय भेषजेभिः ॥
1.95.m: O Rudra, let us not provoke you with good praise, / nor, O Generous One, with joint invocation. / I hear of you as the best physician of physicians; / raise up our men with medicines!

1.95.s: rudra yat te guhyaṃ nāma yat te addhātayo viduḥ | śivā śaravyā yā tava tayā no mṛḍa jīvase ||
1.95.d: रुद्र यत् ते गुह्यं नाम यत् ते अद्धातयो विदुः । शिवा शरव्या या तव तया नो मृड जीवसे ॥
1.95.m: O Rudra, whatever secret name of yours there is, / which the truthful ones know, / whatever auspicious arrow is yours, / with that be gracious to us that we may live!

1.95.s: agniṃ tvāhur vaiśvānaraṃ sadanān pradahan v agāḥ | sa no devatrādhi brūhi mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1.95.d: अग्निं त्वाहुर् वैश्वानरं सदनान् प्रदहन् व् अगाः । स नो देवत्राधि ब्रूहि मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
1.95.m: They call you Agni Vaiśvānara; / burning from their dwellings you have departed. / Speak favorably of us among the gods; / may we not suffer harm from you!

1.95.s: yā devaiḥ prahiteṣuḥ patāt tapase vā mahase vāvasṛṣṭā | somas tvām asmad yāvayatu vidvān avantu naḥ pitaro devahūtiṣu ||
1.95.d: या देवैः प्रहितेषुः पतात् तपसे वा महसे वावसृष्टा । सोमस् त्वाम् अस्मद् यावयतु विद्वान् अवन्तु नः पितरो देवहूतिषु ॥
1.95.m: The arrow shot by the gods that may fly, / discharged either for heat or for majesty— / let the wise Soma ward you off from us! / Let the ancestors help us at the calls to the gods!

1.96.s: rāyaspoṣaṃ dhehi no jātaveda ūrjāvad agne yaśaḥ sūnṛtāvat | dadhāma bhāgaṃ sunavāma somaṃ yajñena tvām upa śikṣema śakra ||
1.96.d: रायस्पोषं धेहि नो जातवेद ऊर्जावद् अग्ने यशः सूनृतावत् । दधाम भागं सुनवाम सोमं यज्ञेन त्वाम् उप शिक्षेम शक्र ॥
1.96.m: Grant us abundance of wealth, O Jātavedas, / vigor-bringing, glorious, true fame, O Agni! / We would assign your share, we would press the soma; / with sacrifice we would serve you, O mighty one!

1.96.s: vayam agne dhanavantaḥ syāma alaṃ yajñāyota dakṣiṇāyai | grāvā vaded abhi somasyāṃśūn endraṃ śikṣemendunā sutena ||
1.96.d: वयम् अग्ने धनवन्तः स्याम अलं यज्ञायोत दक्षिणायै । ग्रावा वदेद् अभि सोमस्यांशून् एन्द्रं शिक्षेमेन्दुना सुतेन ॥
1.96.m: May we be rich in wealth, O Agni, / sufficient for the sacrifice and for the priestly fee! / Let the pressing-stone sound over the stalks of soma; / may we serve Indra with the pressed juice!

1.96.s: īśānaṃ tvā śuśrumā vayaṃ puro dhanānāṃ dhanapate | gomad agne aśvavad bhūri puṣṭaṃ hiraṇyavad annavad dhehi mahyam ||
1.96.d: ईशानं त्वा शुश्रुमा वयं पुरो धनानां धनपते । गोमद् अग्ने अश्ववद् भूरि पुष्टं हिरण्यवद् अन्नवद् धेहि मह्यम् ॥
1.96.m: As the ruler before us we have heard of you, / the master of riches, of treasures! / Abundant prosperity rich in cattle, rich in horses, / rich in gold, rich in food, grant to me, O Agni!

1.96.s: duhāṃ me dyauḥ pṛthivī payo 'jagaro mā sodako 'bhi vi sarpatu | prajāpatinā tanvam ā prīṇe 'riṣṭo ma ātmā ||
1.96.d: दुहां मे द्यौः पृथिवी पयो ऽजगरो मा सोदको ऽभि वि सर्पतु । प्रजापतिना तन्वम् आ प्रीणे ऽरिष्टो म आत्मा ॥
1.96.m: May heaven and earth yield milk for me; / let not the watery boa crawl over me! / Through Prajāpati my body / is fully satisfied; uninjured is my self.

1.97.s: asmāñ juṣadhvam asavo 'dya mā naḥ purā jaraso 'savo vadhiṣṭa | pākā gṛṇīmas tava vīryāya śataṃ himān adhipatir na ehi ||
1.97.d: अस्माञ् जुषध्वम् असवो ऽद्य मा नः पुरा जरसो ऽसवो वधिष्ट । पाका गृणीमस् तव वीर्याय शतं हिमान् अधिपतिर् न एहि ॥
1.97.m: Delight in us today, O vital breaths; / may our vital breaths not [depart] before old age! / Simple ones, we praise your heroic power; / come to us as master for a hundred winters!

1.97.s: un mṛṇo agād ārjunam agāt suśrud bhagavo gopāya mā | ahne 'dyātmānaṃ pari dade sūryaprāṇo bhavāmi ||
1.97.d: उन् मृणो अगाद् आर्जुनम् अगात् सुश्रुद् भगवो गोपाय मा । अह्ने ऽद्यात्मानं परि ददे सूर्यप्राणो भवामि ॥
1.97.m: Upward the slayer has gone, into the bright day he has gone. / O fair-hearing, fortunate one, protect me! / To the day I deliver over myself today; / I become one whose breath is the sun.

1.97.s: ni mṛṇo agād āsitam agāt suśrud bhagavo gopāya mā | rātraye 'dyātmānaṃ pari dade agniprāṇo bhavāmi ||
1.97.d: नि मृणो अगाद् आसितम् अगात् सुश्रुद् भगवो गोपाय मा । रात्रये ऽद्यात्मानं परि ददे अग्निप्राणो भवामि ॥
1.97.m: Downward the slayer has gone, into the dark night he has gone. / O fair-hearing, fortunate one, protect me! / To the night I deliver over myself today; / I become one whose breath is the fire.

1.97.s: anābhūr asy anābho 'nābhuvo bhūyāsma | sa yatra tvaṃ prajāpate trir ekasyāhnaḥ prajāḥ saṃpaśyasi | tatra mām api saṃ paśya anaṣṭapaśur bhuvanasya gopāḥ ||
1.97.d: अनाभूर् अस्य् अनाभो ऽनाभुवो भूयास्म । स यत्र त्वं प्रजापते त्रिर् एकस्याह्नः प्रजाः संपश्यसि । तत्र माम् अपि सं पश्य अनष्टपशुर् भुवनस्य गोपाः ॥
1.97.m: You are not failing, O un-failing one; / may we be non-failing! / Where you, O Prajāpati, / look over the creatures three times in a single day, / there look upon me as well, / one whose cattle are not lost, O protector of the world!

1.98.s: yathā mṛgaṃ ropayasi tiraś carmātividhyasi | evā tvam ugra oṣadhe amuṃ ropaya mām abhi ||
1.98.d: यथा मृगं रोपयसि तिरश् चर्मातिविध्यसि । एवा त्वम् उग्र ओषधे अमुं रोपय माम् अभि ॥
1.98.m: Just as you bring down the deer / and pierce through its hide, / so do you, O fierce herb, / bring that person down to me!

1.98.s: bandhaś cemā upadhiś ca madhuman nau samañjanam | dvārau bhagasyemā ūrū mṛgas tṛṣyann ivā cara ||
1.98.d: बन्धश् चेमा उपधिश् च मधुमन् नौ समञ्जनम् । द्वारौ भगस्येमा ऊरू मृगस् तृष्यन्न् इवा चर ॥
1.98.m: These are the bonds and the felloe; / sweet is the anointing between us two. / These thighs are the two doors of fortune; / approach like a thirsty beast!

1.98.s: abhi tvādhām abhidhinā jāleneva mahājaṣam | yathā mama kratāv aso mama citte sacāvahai ||
1.98.d: अभि त्वाधाम् अभिधिना जालेनेव महाजषम् । यथा मम क्रताव् असो मम चित्ते सचावहै ॥
1.98.m: I encompass you with a band, / as a great fish with a net, / so that you may be in my intention, / that we two may walk in my thought!

1.98.s: ahaṃ vai tvad uttarāsmy adha tvam upadhir mama | saṃ nau badhnāmi saṃbandhanena yathāsāvāvicartyāv ā mṛtyor ā parāvataḥ ||
1.98.d: अहं वै त्वद् उत्तरास्म्य् अध त्वम् उपधिर् मम । सं नौ बध्नामि संबन्धनेन यथासावाविचर्त्याव् आ मृत्योर् आ परावतः ॥
1.98.m: I indeed [am above] you; / then you are my felloe. / I bind the two of us together with a joint bond, / so that we two shall not be parted, / unto death, unto the distance!

1.99.s: apocchantī duṣvapnyam apa durhārdam ucchatam | apoṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ kṣetriyaṃ sarvāś ca yātudhānyaḥ ||
1.99.d: अपोच्छन्ती दुष्वप्न्यम् अप दुर्हार्दम् उच्छतम् । अपोष्टं सर्वं क्षेत्रियं सर्वाश् च यातुधान्यः ॥
1.99.m: Driving away bad dreams, / driving away ill-will, / driven away is all kṣetriya-disease / and all sorceresses.

1.99.s: ud agātāṃ bhagavatī vicṛtau nāma tārake | vi kṣetriyasya muñcatāṃ saṃgranthiṃ hṛdayasya ca ||
1.99.d: उद् अगातां भगवती विचृतौ नाम तारके । वि क्षेत्रियस्य मुञ्चतां संग्रन्थिं हृदयस्य च ॥
1.99.m: The two fortunate stars / named the Unfasteners have arisen. / Let them untie the knot / of kṣetriya-disease and of the heart!

1.99.s: namo astu varatrābhyo nama īṣāyugebhyaḥ | mṛgāyāraṇye tiṣṭhate kṣetriyāyākaraṃ namaḥ ||
1.99.d: नमो अस्तु वरत्राभ्यो नम ईषायुगेभ्यः । मृगायारण्ये तिष्ठते क्षेत्रियायाकरं नमः ॥
1.99.m: Homage be to the straps, / homage to the poles and yokes! / To the beast standing in the forest, / to kṣetriya-disease I have paid homage.

1.99.s: ākhor idaṃ kṣaitrapatyaṃ manoś ca mānavasya ca | manaḥ sarvasya paśyata iha bhūyaḥ syād iti ||
1.99.d: आखोर् इदं क्षैत्रपत्यं मनोश् च मानवस्य च । मनः सर्वस्य पश्यत इह भूयः स्याद् इति ॥
1.99.m: This lordship of the field belongs to the mole, / and to Manu, and to the son of Manu. / Behold the mind of everyone, / that it should be greater here!

1.100.s: ud ehi devi kanya ācitā vasunā saha | na tvā taranty oṣadhayo bāhyāḥ parvatīyā uta ||
1.100.d: उद् एहि देवि कन्य आचिता वसुना सह । न त्वा तरन्त्य् ओषधयो बाह्याः पर्वतीया उत ॥
1.100.m: Rise up, O divine maiden, / piled up together with wealth! / The herbs from outside / and from the mountains do not surpass you.

1.100.s: yathā tvā devy oṣadhe sarvaḥ kāmayate janaḥ | evā bhagasya no dhehi devebhya ivāmṛtaṃ pari ||
1.100.d: यथा त्वा देव्य् ओषधे सर्वः कामयते जनः । एवा भगस्य नो धेहि देवेभ्य इवामृतं परि ॥
1.100.m: Just as every person, O divine herb, / desires you, / so bestow upon us fortune, / as the nectar from the gods!

1.100.s: utsaktapatny oṣadha āvataṃkaraṇīd asi | yad eṣi yan niṣīdasi tatra tvāhaṃ sam agrabham aśvam ivāśvābhidhānyā ||
1.100.d: उत्सक्तपत्न्य् ओषध आवतंकरणीद् असि । यद् एषि यन् निषीदसि तत्र त्वाहं सम् अग्रभम् अश्वम् इवाश्वाभिधान्या ॥
1.100.m: O herb whose husband is loosened, / you are the maker of deep pits. / Where you go, where you sit down, / there I have seized you, / like a horse with a horse's halter.

1.100.s: yathā kumāras taruṇo mātaraṃ pratinandati | evāsmān prati nandatu yāṃ vayaṃ kāmayāmahe ||
1.100.d: यथा कुमारस् तरुणो मातरं प्रतिनन्दति । एवास्मान् प्रति नन्दतु यां वयं कामयामहे ॥
1.100.m: Just as a young boy / welcomes his mother, / so let her welcome us, / whom we desire!

1.101.s: trīṇi pātrāṇi prathamāny āsan tāni satyam uta bhūtaṃ tatakṣa | ṛtasya māne adhi yā dhruvāṇy ebhir devā amṛtaṃ bhakṣayanti ||
1.101.d: त्रीणि पात्राणि प्रथमान्य् आसन् तानि सत्यम् उत भूतं ततक्ष । ऋतस्य माने अधि या ध्रुवाण्य् एभिर् देवा अमृतं भक्षयन्ति ॥
1.101.m: Three vessels were there at the beginning; / truth and reality fashioned them. / Those which are fixed upon the measure of order— / with these the gods feast on immortality.

1.101.s: svar yad devā vibhajanta āyan trīṇi pātrāṇi prathamāny āsan | ādityā ekaṃ vasavo dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ rudrā adhi saṃ babhūvuḥ ||
1.101.d: स्वर् यद् देवा विभजन्त आयन् त्रीणि पात्राणि प्रथमान्य् आसन् । आदित्या एकं वसवो द्वितीयं तृतीयं रुद्रा अधि सं बभूवुः ॥
1.101.m: When the gods went dividing the heavenly light, / three vessels were there at the beginning: / the Ādityas became masters of the first, the Vasus of the second, / the Rudras of the third.

1.101.s: dhātā veda savitaitāni sarvā bṛhaspatiḥ prathamo devo agniḥ | ebhir indro jaṭharam āpṛṇīte tribhiḥ pātrair uta viśve ca devāḥ ||
1.101.d: धाता वेद सवितैतानि सर्वा बृहस्पतिः प्रथमो देवो अग्निः । एभिर् इन्द्रो जठरम् आपृणीते त्रिभिः पात्रैर् उत विश्वे च देवाः ॥
1.101.m: Dhātṛ knows all these, Savitṛ, / Bṛhaspati, the first god Agni. / With these Indra fills his belly, / and all the gods with the three vessels.

1.101.s: ūrdhvā tiṣṭhanti na nu jihmā bhavanti nonaṃ babhūva katamac canaiṣām | devānāṃ pātrāṇi nihitāni yāni tāni saṃ pāti ya ṛtasya gopaḥ ||
1.101.d: ऊर्ध्वा तिष्ठन्ति न नु जिह्मा भवन्ति नोनं बभूव कतमच् चनैषाम् । देवानां पात्राणि निहितानि यानि तानि सं पाति य ऋतस्य गोपः ॥
1.101.m: They stand upright, nor indeed do they become crooked; / not one of them has become deficient. / The vessels of the gods that have been deposited, / those he protects together who is the guardian of order.

1.102.s: paurṇamāsī prathamā yajñiyāsīd ahnāṃ rātrīṇām atiśarvareṣu | ye tvāṃ yajñair yajñiye bodhayanty amī te nākaṃ sukṛtaḥ paretāḥ ||
1.102.d: पौर्णमासी प्रथमा यज्ञियासीद् अह्नां रात्रीणाम् अतिशर्वरेषु । ये त्वां यज्ञैर् यज्ञिये बोधयन्त्य् अमी ते नाकं सुकृतः परेताः ॥
1.102.m: The Full Moon night was the first worthy of sacrifice / beyond the dark nights of the days. / Those who awaken you with sacrifices, / these well-doers have departed to the firmament.

1.102.s: pūrṇā paścād uta pūrṇā purastāt paurṇamāsī madhyata uj jigāya | tasyāṃ devaiḥ saṃvasanto mahitvā nākasya pṛṣṭhe sam iṣā madema ||
1.102.d: पूर्णा पश्चाद् उत पूर्णा पुरस्तात् पौर्णमासी मध्यत उज् जिगाय । तस्यां देवैः संवसन्तो महित्वा नाकस्य पृष्ठे सम् इषा मदेम ॥
1.102.m: Full behind and full in front, / the Full Moon night has risen in the middle. / Dwelling together with the gods in greatness on her, / may we revel with refreshment upon the back of the firmament!

1.102.s: catasro diśaḥ pradiśo ha pañca ṣaḍ urvīr āhū rajaso vimānīḥ | dvādaśa rtava ārtavāś ca te mā ā pyāyayantu bhuvanasya gopāḥ ||
1.102.d: चतस्रो दिशः प्रदिशो ह पञ्च षड् उर्वीर् आहू रजसो विमानीः । द्वादश र्तव आर्तवाश् च ते मा आ प्याययन्तु भुवनस्य गोपाः ॥
1.102.m: The four quarters, and five intermediate directions, / the six broad realms that measure out the space, / the twelve seasons and the seasonal periods— / let them, the guardians of the world, swell me!

1.102.s: yathādityā aṃśum āpyāyayanti yam akṣitam akṣitayaḥ pibanti | evā mām indro varuṇo bṛhaspatir ā pyāyayantu bhuvanasya gopāḥ ||
1.102.d: यथादित्या अंशुम् आप्याययन्ति यम् अक्षितम् अक्षितयः पिबन्ति । एवा माम् इन्द्रो वरुणो बृहस्पतिर् आ प्याययन्तु भुवनस्य गोपाः ॥
1.102.m: Just as the Ādityas cause the stalk to swell, / which the imperishable ones drink as imperishable, / even so let Indra, Varuṇa, Bṛhaspati, / the guardians of the world, swell me!

1.103.s: āgan rātrī saṃgamanī vasūnāṃ viśvaṃ puṣṭaṃ vasv āveśayantī | amāvāsyāyai haviṣā vidhema ūrjaṃ vasānā payasā na āgan ||
1.103.d: आगन् रात्री संगमनी वसूनां विश्वं पुष्टं वस्व् आवेशयन्ती । अमावास्यायै हविषा विधेम ऊर्जं वसाना पयसा न आगन् ॥
1.103.m: The night has arrived, gatherer of goods, / bringing to enter all thriving and wealth. / We would worship the New Moon night with an oblation; / clothed in vigor, she has come to us with milk.

1.103.s: mā tvā rātri puro daghan mota paścād vibhāvari | āyuṣmantaḥ suprajasaḥ suvīrā ṛdhyāsma tvā suvarcasaḥ ||
1.103.d: मा त्वा रात्रि पुरो दघन् मोत पश्चाद् विभावरि । आयुष्मन्तः सुप्रजसः सुवीरा ऋध्यास्म त्वा सुवर्चसः ॥
1.103.m: Let not the night burn you from in front, / nor from behind, O luminous one! / Long-lived, having good offspring, having good sons, / endowed with splendor, may we prosper through you!

1.103.s: yasya devasya sumatau sunītir eti sumatiṃ gṛhāṇām | ā mā puṣṭaṃ ca poṣyaṃ ca rātryā devānāṃ sumatau syāma ||
1.103.d: यस्य देवस्य सुमतौ सुनीतिर् एति सुमतिं गृहाणाम् । आ मा पुष्टं च पोष्यं च रात्र्या देवानां सुमतौ स्याम ॥
1.103.m: Under whichever god's favor good guidance / goes to the favor of our homes, / [bring] to me both thriving and prosperity; / through the night may we be in the favor of the gods!

1.103.s: aham evāsmy amāvāsyā amā vasanti sukṛto mayīme | mayi devā ubhaye sādhyāś ca indrajyeṣṭhāḥ sam agacchanta sarve ||
1.103.d: अहम् एवास्म्य् अमावास्या अमा वसन्ति सुकृतो मयीमे । मयि देवा उभये साध्याश् च इन्द्रज्येष्ठाः सम् अगच्छन्त सर्वे ॥
1.103.m: I myself am the New Moon night; / together in me dwell these well-doers. / In me the gods, both [classes] and the Sādhyas, / with Indra as their eldest, are gathered all together.

1.104.s: prathamā ha vy uvāsa sā dhenur abhavad yame | sā naḥ payasvatī duhā uttarāmuttarāṃ samām ||
1.104.d: प्रथमा ह व्य् उवास सा धेनुर् अभवद् यमे । सा नः पयस्वती दुहा उत्तरामुत्तरां समाम् ॥
1.104.m: She indeed shone forth first; / she became a milch-cow in Yama's [realm]. / Full of milk, may she yield [milk] for us / for year after succeeding year!

1.104.s: yāṃ devāḥ pratinandanti dhenuṃ rātrīm upāyatīm | saṃvatsarasya yā patnī sā no astu sumaṅgalī ||
1.104.d: यां देवाः प्रतिनन्दन्ति धेनुं रात्रीम् उपायतीम् । संवत्सरस्य या पत्नी सा नो अस्तु सुमङ्गली ॥
1.104.m: Whom the gods greet with joy, / the milch-cow, the Night, / she who is the wife of the year, / may she be very auspicious to us!

1.104.s: saṃvatsarasya pratimāṃ ye tvā rātry upāsate | teṣām āyuṣmatīṃ prajāṃ rāyaspoṣeṇa saṃ sṛja ||
1.104.d: संवत्सरस्य प्रतिमां ये त्वा रात्र्य् उपासते । तेषाम् आयुष्मतीं प्रजां रायस्पोषेण सं सृज ॥
1.104.m: O Night, those who worship you / as the image of the year, / unite their long-lived offspring / with abundance of wealth!

1.104.s: iyam eva sā yā prathamā vyaucchat sāpsv antar āsu carati praviṣṭā | vadhūr jigāya navagaj janitrī traya enāṃ mahimānaḥ sacante ||
1.104.d: इयम् एव सा या प्रथमा व्यौच्छत् साप्स्व् अन्तर् आसु चरति प्रविष्टा । वधूर् जिगाय नवगज् जनित्री त्रय एनां महिमानः सचन्ते ॥
1.104.m: This is indeed she who shone forth first; / entered into these waters, she moves within. / The bride has conquered, bearing nine, the mother; / three greatnesses accompany her.

1.105.s: vānaspatyā grāvāṇo ghoṣam akrata haviṣ kṛṇvantaḥ parivatsarīṇam | ekāṣṭake suprajasaḥ suvīrā vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
1.105.d: वानस्पत्या ग्रावाणो घोषम् अक्रत हविष् कृण्वन्तः परिवत्सरीणम् । एकाष्टके सुप्रजसः सुवीरा वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥
1.105.m: The wooden pressing-stones have made their sound, / preparing the oblation of the full year. / O Ekāṣṭakā, having good offspring, having good sons, / may we be masters of riches!

1.105.s: iḍāyās padaṃ ghṛtavat sarīsṛpaṃ jātavedaḥ prati havyā gṛbhāya | ye grāmyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpās teṣāṃ saptānāṃ mayi rantir astu ||
1.105.d: इडायास् पदं घृतवत् सरीसृपं जातवेदः प्रति हव्या गृभाय । ये ग्राम्याः पशवो विश्वरूपास् तेषां सप्तानां मयि रन्तिर् अस्तु ॥
1.105.m: The footprint of Iḍā, full of ghee, creeping— / O Jātavedas, accept the oblations! / Whatever domestic animals of all forms there are, / of those seven may there be delight in me!

1.105.s: iḍayā juhvato havir devān ghṛtavatā yaje | gṛhān alubhyato vayaṃ dṛṣadomopa gomataḥ ||
1.105.d: इडया जुह्वतो हविर् देवान् घृतवता यजे । गृहान् अलुभ्यतो वयं दृषदोमोप गोमतः ॥
1.105.m: Offering the oblation with Iḍā, / I worship the gods with [an offering] rich in ghee, / we [desiring] homes that are not greedy, / rich in cattle […].

1.105.s: yaja rtubhya ārtavebhyo mādbhyaḥ saṃvatsarāya ca | dhātre vidhartre samṛdhe bhūtasya pataye yaja ||
1.105.d: यज र्तुभ्य आर्तवेभ्यो माद्भ्यः संवत्सराय च । धात्रे विधर्त्रे समृधे भूतस्य पतये यज ॥
1.105.m: To the seasons, to the seasonal [deities], / to the months and to the year, / to the Creator, the Disposer, the Prosperer, / to the Lord of Being, offer sacrifice!

1.106.s: āyam agan saṃvatsaraḥ patir ekāṣṭake tava | tasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema sa u naḥ śarma yacchatu ||
1.106.d: आयम् अगन् संवत्सरः पतिर् एकाष्टके तव । तस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम स उ नः शर्म यच्छतु ॥
1.106.m: This year has come, / your husband, O Ekāṣṭakā. / To that god let us pay homage with oblation; / and may he grant us protection!

1.106.s: ekāṣṭakāyai haviṣā vidhema ya rtūn pañcānu praviṣṭā | sasyena sasyam upasaṃcaranto ariṣṭāsa ṛtuna rtum upa saṃ carema ||
1.106.d: एकाष्टकायै हविषा विधेम य र्तून् पञ्चानु प्रविष्टा । सस्येन सस्यम् उपसंचरन्तो अरिष्टास ऋतुन र्तुम् उप सं चरेम ॥
1.106.m: To the Ekāṣṭakā let us pay homage with oblation, / who has entered along into the five seasons. / Moving through harvest upon harvest, / uninjured, may we move along through season upon season!

1.106.s: vasanto grīṣmo madhumanta varṣāḥ śarad dhemanta ṛtavo no juṣantām | ā no goṣu bhajantv ā prajāyāṃ suśarmaṇy eṣāṃ trivarūthe syāma ||
1.106.d: वसन्तो ग्रीष्मो मधुमन्त वर्षाः शरद् धेमन्त ऋतवो नो जुषन्ताम् । आ नो गोषु भजन्त्व् आ प्रजायां सुशर्मण्य् एषां त्रिवरूथे स्याम ॥
1.106.m: May spring, summer, the honey-rich rains, / autumn, winter, the seasons delight in us! / May they apportion [wealth] to us in cattle, in offspring; / may we be in their safe, threefold shelter!

1.106.s: ekāṣṭakā tapasā tapyamānā jajāna garbhaṃ mahimānam indram | tena devā vy aṣahanta śatrūn hantāsurāṇām abhavac chacīpatiḥ ||
1.106.d: एकाष्टका तपसा तप्यमाना जजान गर्भं महिमानम् इन्द्रम् । तेन देवा व्य् अषहन्त शत्रून् हन्तासुराणाम् अभवच् छचीपतिः ॥
1.106.m: The Ekāṣṭakā, practicing heat through asceticism, / gave birth to the embryo, the greatness, Indra. / Through him the gods overpowered their enemies; / the Lord of Might became the slayer of the asuras.

1.106.s: pūrṇā darve parā pata supūrṇā punar ā pata | sarvān yajñān saṃ pṛñcati iṣam ūrjaṃ na ā bhara ||
1.106.d: पूर्णा दर्वे परा पत सुपूर्णा पुनर् आ पत । सर्वान् यज्ञान् सं पृञ्चति इषम् ऊर्जं न आ भर ॥
1.106.m: Full, O ladle, fly forth; / very full, fly back here! / Bringing all sacrifices together, / bring to us food [and] vigor!

1.106.s: iṣam ūrjaṃ na ābhṛtya iḍayā paśubhiḥ saha | sarasvati tvam asmāsu rāyaspoṣaṃ ni yaccha ||
1.106.d: इषम् ऊर्जं न आभृत्य इडया पशुभिः सह । सरस्वति त्वम् अस्मासु रायस्पोषं नि यच्छ ॥
1.106.m: Having brought to us food [and] vigor, / together with Iḍā, with cattle, / O Sarasvatī, do you bestow / abundance of wealth upon us!

1.107.s: vātasya nu mahimā rathasya ārujann eti stanayann asya ghoṣaḥ | divaspṛg ety aruṇāni kṛṇvann atho eti pṛthivyā reṇum asyan ||
1.107.d: वातस्य नु महिमा रथस्य आरुजन्न् एति स्तनयन्न् अस्य घोषः । दिवस्पृग् एत्य् अरुणानि कृण्वन्न् अथो एति पृथिव्या रेणुम् अस्यन् ॥
1.107.m: Now the greatness of Vāta's chariot: / shattering it goes, thundering is its roar. / Touching the sky it goes, making ruddy [hues], / and then it goes, casting up the dust of the earth.

1.107.s: saṃ prerate anu vātasya viṣṭhā ainaṃ gacchanti samaneva yoṣāḥ | tābhir vidvān sarathaṃ deva īyate patir viśvasya bhuvanasya gopāḥ ||
1.107.d: सं प्रेरते अनु वातस्य विष्ठा ऐनं गच्छन्ति समनेव योषाः । ताभिर् विद्वान् सरथं देव ईयते पतिर् विश्वस्य भुवनस्य गोपाः ॥
1.107.m: Together they rush forth along Vāta's [path]; / they come to him like women to a festival. / With them the wise god goes in the same chariot, / the king of the whole world, the guardian.

1.107.s: ātmā devānāṃ bhuvanasya gopā yathāvaśaṃ carati deva eṣaḥ | ghoṣa id asya śrūyate na rūpaṃ tasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
1.107.d: आत्मा देवानां भुवनस्य गोपा यथावशं चरति देव एषः । घोष इद् अस्य श्रूयते न रूपं तस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
1.107.m: The breath of the gods, the guardian of the world, / this god wanders according to his will. / His sound alone is heard, not his form. / To that god let us pay homage with oblation!

1.107.s: antarikṣe pathibhir īyamāno na ni viśate katamac canāhaḥ | apāṃ yoniḥ prathamajā ṛtasya kva svij jātaḥ kuta ā babhūva ||
1.107.d: अन्तरिक्षे पथिभिर् ईयमानो न नि विशते कतमच् चनाहः । अपां योनिः प्रथमजा ऋतस्य क्व स्विज् जातः कुत आ बभूव ॥
1.107.m: Speeding along paths in the intermediate space, / he does not rest on any day whatever. / The womb of the waters, the firstborn of truth, / where was he born, whence did he arise?

1.107.s: antarikṣe patayantaṃ vāta tvām āśum āśubhiḥ | paśyanti sarve cakṣuṣā na sarve manasā viduḥ ||
1.107.d: अन्तरिक्षे पतयन्तं वात त्वाम् आशुम् आशुभिः । पश्यन्ति सर्वे चक्षुषा न सर्वे मनसा विदुः ॥
1.107.m: Flying in the intermediate space, / you, O Vāta, swift with your swift [steeds], / all see with the eye; / not all know with the mind.

1.107.s: upatrikaṃ saṃcavicaṃ triryamaṃ caturekajam | taṃ mātariśvānaṃ devaṃ divo devā avāsṛjan ||
1.107.d: उपत्रिकं संचविचं त्रिर्यमं चतुरेकजम् । तं मातरिश्वानं देवं दिवो देवा अवासृजन् ॥
1.107.m: The one having three near, the moving, / three-guided, four-and-one-born: / that god, Mātariśvan, / the gods sent down from heaven.

1.108.s: apa ny adhuḥ pauruṣeyaṃ vadhaṃ mad indrāgnī dhātā savitā bṛhaspatiḥ | somo rājā varuṇo aśvinā yamaḥ pūṣāsmān pari pātu mṛtyoḥ ||
1.108.d: अप न्य् अधुः पौरुषेयं वधं मद् इन्द्राग्नी धाता सविता बृहस्पतिः । सोमो राजा वरुणो अश्विना यमः पूषास्मान् परि पातु मृत्योः ॥
1.108.m: Indra and Agni, Dhātṛ, Savitṛ, Bṛhaspati / have averted from me human weapon; / may King Soma, Varuṇa, the Aśvins, Yama, / [and] Pūṣan protect us all around from death!

1.108.s: yāni cakāra bhuvanasya yas patiḥ prajāpatir mātariśvā prajābhyaḥ | pradiśo yāni vasate diśaś ca tāni me varmāṇi bahulāni santu ||
1.108.d: यानि चकार भुवनस्य यस् पतिः प्रजापतिर् मातरिश्वा प्रजाभ्यः । प्रदिशो यानि वसते दिशश् च तानि मे वर्माणि बहुलानि सन्तु ॥
1.108.m: What the Lord of the world, / Prajāpati, Mātariśvan, made for his creatures, / what he puts on as the intermediate quarters and the quarters, / let those be my thick armors!

1.108.s: yat tanuṣv anahyanta devā dvirājayodhinaḥ | indro yac cakre varma tad asmān pātu viśvataḥ ||
1.108.d: यत् तनुष्व् अनह्यन्त देवा द्विराजयोधिनः । इन्द्रो यच् चक्रे वर्म तद् अस्मान् पातु विश्वतः ॥
1.108.m: What on your bodies / the gods, fighting against two kings, [fashioned]— / what armor Indra made, / let that protect us from every side!

1.108.s: varma me dyāvāpṛthivī varmāhar varma sūryaḥ | varma me viśve devāḥ kran mā mā prāpat pratīcikā ||
1.108.d: वर्म मे द्यावापृथिवी वर्माहर् वर्म सूर्यः । वर्म मे विश्वे देवाः क्रन् मा मा प्रापत् प्रतीचिका ॥
1.108.m: My armor is heaven and earth, / my armor is the sun, / my armor all the gods have made; / let not the downward-turned [shaft] reach me!

1.109.s: somārudrā vi vṛhataṃ viṣūcīm amīvā yā no gayam āviveśa | bādhethāṃ dveṣo nirṛtiṃ parācaiḥ kṛtaṃ cid enaḥ pra mumuktam asmat ||
1.109.d: सोमारुद्रा वि वृहतं विषूचीम् अमीवा या नो गयम् आविवेश । बाधेथां द्वेषो निरृतिं पराचैः कृतं चिद् एनः प्र मुमुक्तम् अस्मत् ॥
1.109.m: O Soma and Rudra, tear out in all directions / the disease that has entered our household; / drive hatred [and] Nirṛti far away; / even the sin that has been committed, loosen from us!
